roadmap.title: Score, colors and early prestige
roadmap.description: Raise your Score, buy colors, and use Prestige, Ascension and Promotions.

roadmap.title: Infinity, generators and challenges
roadmap.description: Reach Infinity, unlock Generators, Stars and Challenges, and break Infinity.

roadmap.title: Eternity, animals and research
roadmap.description: Go Eternal, buy animals, spend research points, and begin Eternity Challenges.

roadmap.title: Eternity challenges, Supernova and Dilation
roadmap.description: Finish Eternity Challenges, reach higher Supernovas, and grow Dilation and the Dilation Tree.

roadmap.title: Unity, zodiacs and trials
roadmap.description: Unite for the first time, equip zodiacs on planets, and clear trials.

roadmap.title: Attacks, relics and polish
roadmap.description: Level Attacks, buy and sacrifice relics, and work through polish weapons.

roadmap.title: Minerals, merging and refinement
roadmap.description: Spawn and merge minerals, use Special Minerals, and buy Refine Nodes.

roadmap.title: Elements and runes
roadmap.description: Collect elements and Sun and Moon runes, and buy element nodes.

roadmap.title: Tarot cards and challenges
roadmap.description: Draw Tarot cards, upgrade each suit, and clear the Tarot challenges.

roadmap.title: Artifacts and zodiac rarities
roadmap.description: Collect artifact parts, level artifacts, and push zodiac rarity and level.

roadmap.title: Plague
roadmap.description: Unlock the Plague tab, craft Endoplasmic Reticulum, and clear the plague stages.

roadmap.title: Singularity
roadmap.description: Perform Singularities, grow the Singularity Multiplier, and use Singular Zodiacs.

roadmap.title: Playtime and whole-game milestones
roadmap.description: Earn achievements for total playtime, achievement counts and other whole-game goals.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1,000,000.

steps.text: Buy circle levels with Score so your laps earn faster, until your Score reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Ascend a circle for the first time.

steps.text: Buy levels of Red until it reaches its level cap of 100, then ascend it.
steps.note: Ascending sets the circle back to level 5 and raises its cap by 10.

achievements.summary: Buy a level of the Blue circle.

steps.text: Unlock each circle in turn by buying 5 levels of the one before it: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Turquoise, then Cyan.
Buy a level of Blue, which costs 1e12 Score.

achievements.summary: Prestige for the first time.

steps.text: Raise your Score to 1e10 (10B) to unlock @mechanic{Prestige}.
Open the Prestige window and prestige.
steps.note: This resets your Score, circle upgrades and ascensions.

achievements.summary: Open the credits screen.

steps.text: Press the @loc{Credits} button in the lower-right corner of the Revolution screen.

achievements.summary: Make any one color multiplier go above 1,000.

steps.text: Keep your circles running and ascend them, until one of the color multipliers at the top of the screen is above 1,000.
steps.note: Each lap adds that circle's Mult Gain to its multiplier.

achievements.summary: Ascend one circle twice so it reaches Ascension 2.

steps.text: Ascend a circle at level cap 100, then buy it back up to its new cap of 110 and ascend it again.

achievements.summary: Prestige two times.

steps.text: Prestige once.
Build your Score back up to your last prestige point to open the Prestige window again, then prestige a second time.

achievements.summary: Reach a Prestige Multiplier (P.Mult) of x1,000.

steps.text: Build Score and prestige when the Prestige window shows a P.Mult of x1,000 or more.
steps.note: A higher Score at prestige gives a higher P.Mult.

achievements.summary: Buy a level of the White circle.

steps.text: Unlock each circle in turn by buying 5 levels of the one before it, up to Pink.
Buy a level of White, which costs 1e27 Score.

achievements.summary: Raise your Prestige Exponent (P.Exponent) to 1.1.

steps.text: Prestige at a higher Score each time, because the P.Exponent you gain grows with the Score you prestige at. Check it in the Prestige window.

achievements.summary: Promote for the first time.

steps.text: Raise your P.Mult above x1,000. The upcoming P.Mult in the Prestige window counts.
Choose one of the four promotion boosts and promote.
steps.note: Promoting resets your progress up to that point.

achievements.summary: Get one circle to 10 laps per second so it shows as a solid circle.

steps.text: Buy levels of Red, the circle with the fastest base lap speed, until it reaches 10 laps per second.
steps.note: Turn on "show tooltip" in settings, then press and hold a circle to see its laps per second.

achievements.summary: Reach a Prestige Multiplier (P.Mult) of x1,000,000.

steps.text: Build Score and prestige when the Prestige window shows a P.Mult of x1,000,000 or more.

achievements.summary: Reach 5 hours of Unscaled Playtime.

steps.text: Keep the game running until Unscaled Playtime reaches 5 hours.
steps.note: Find it on the Global tab of the Statistics page.

achievements.summary: Raise your Prestige Exponent (P.Exponent) to 1.2.

steps.text: Prestige at a higher Score each time, because the P.Exponent you gain grows with the Score you prestige at. Check it in the Prestige window.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e63.

steps.text: Raise your Score to 1e63 by buying and ascending circles and by prestiging.

achievements.summary: Make every color multiplier go above 1,000.

steps.text: Check the multipliers at the top of the screen and keep buying and ascending circles until all of them are above 1,000.

achievements.summary: Get one Promotion to level 10.

steps.text: Promote again and again with the same promotion boost until it reaches level 10.
steps.note: A higher P.Mult gives more promotion experience.

achievements.description: Make all promotions be at least lv.10
achievements.summary: Get all four Promotions to at least level 10.

steps.text: Promote until all four promotions are at level 10: the first raises Mult Gain Mult, the second Laps Speed Mult, the third Ascension Power and the fourth Promotion Power.
steps.note: Go through them from the first to the fourth, then repeat.

achievements.summary: Promote without Prestiging.

steps.text: Build Score without prestiging until the upcoming P.Mult in the Prestige window is above x1,000, then promote instead.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e100.

steps.text: Raise your Score to 1e100 by buying and ascending circles and by prestiging.

achievements.summary: Raise a circle's base Mult Gain to at least 1.

steps.text: Ascend a circle until its Mult Gain is x1 or more.
steps.note: Turn on "show tooltip" in settings, then press and hold a circle to see its Mult Gain.

achievements.description: Multiply your P.Mult by 1M in one prestige
achievements.summary: Make your Prestige Multiplier (P.Mult) 1,000,000 times higher with one Prestige.

steps.text: Before you prestige, compare the new P.Mult in the Prestige window with your current P.Mult, and prestige once the new one is 1,000,000 times larger.

achievements.summary: Prestige while only three colors are unlocked.

steps.text: Use only Red, Orange and Yellow, and stop before buying 5 levels of Yellow, because that unlocks Green.
Raise your Score to 1e10 and prestige.

achievements.summary: Promote without Prestiging and without Ascending.

steps.text: Build Score with no prestige and no ascension until the upcoming P.Mult is above x1,000, then promote.

achievements.description: Red, orange and yellow are at 6th ascension
achievements.summary: Get Red, Orange and Yellow to Ascension 6.

steps.text: Ascend Red, Orange and Yellow six times each.
steps.note: Each ascension drops the circle to level 5 and lifts its level cap by 10.

achievements.description: Make all promotions be at least lv.50
achievements.summary: Get all four Promotions to at least level 50.

steps.text: Promote until all four promotions are at level 50: the first raises Mult Gain Mult, the second Laps Speed Mult, the third Ascension Power and the fourth Promotion Power.

achievements.description: Make white mult > pink mult > purple mult, etc...
achievements.summary: Make the color multipliers rank White above Pink above Purple and so on down to Red.

steps.text: Compare the multipliers at the top of the screen in this order: White, Pink, Purple, Blue, Cyan, Turquoise, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red.
Keep buying and ascending circles until each color multiplier is higher than the next one in that order.

achievements.summary: Perform your first Infinity by reaching 1.79e308 Score and choosing Infinite.

steps.text: Raise your Score to 1.79e308.
steps.note: Around level 75 on every Promotion is a good target before this.

steps.text: Choose the Infinite option to claim Infinity Points (IP).
steps.note: This resets your Score, colors, ascensions, prestige and promotions.

achievements.summary: Get all ten circles to 10 laps per second so every circle is solid.

steps.text: Raise the laps per second of every circle to 10 or more.
steps.note: Infinity Upgrades such as Fast Laps (3;1) and Even Faster Laps (4;1) raise lap speed.

achievements.summary: Reach 10 Generator Power (GP).

steps.text: Complete your first Infinity, which gives you Infinity Points (IP).
Spend IP on Generator 1 in the Infinity layer and let it run until Generator Power (GP) reaches 10.

achievements.summary: Reach Infinity two times.

steps.text: Reach 1.79e308 Score again after your first Infinity and choose Infinite.

achievements.summary: Reach Infinity within one hour of starting that Infinity run.

steps.text: Buy Infinity Upgrades that raise your speed, then reach 1.79e308 Score and Infinite in under one hour.
steps.note: The Infinity tab of the Statistics page shows your run time.

achievements.summary: Unlock Automations by buying the first Infinity Upgrade, 1;1.

steps.text: Infinite once, then open the Infinity tab and buy upgrade 1;1 for 1 Infinity Point (IP).

achievements.summary: Reach 5 Infinities.

steps.text: Infinite five times in total.

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000 Generator Power (GP).

steps.text: Complete your first Infinity, which gives you Infinity Points (IP).
Spend IP on Generator 1 in the Infinity layer and let it run until Generator Power (GP) reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Buy a second time first generator
achievements.summary: Buy Generator 1 a second time.

steps.text: Complete your first Infinity, which gives you Infinity Points (IP).
Spend IP on Generator 1 in the Infinity layer, and buy it two times.

achievements.summary: Reach Infinity while every Promotion is below level 20.

steps.text: Keep all four Promotions under level 20 for the whole run, then reach 1.79e308 Score and Infinite.
steps.note: Turn Auto Promote off.

achievements.summary: Unlock Infinity Challenges by buying the upgrade Challenges! (7;1).

steps.text: Buy upgrades down the Infinity tree until you can afford Challenges! (7;1), which costs 5 Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Complete Infinity Challenge 1, Ionized Speed.

steps.text: Start Challenge 1, where Promotions 2 and 4 are disabled.
Reach 1.79e308 Score and Infinite inside the challenge.

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000,000 Generator Power (GP).

steps.text: Complete your first Infinity, which gives you Infinity Points (IP).
Spend IP on Generators in the Infinity layer and let them run until Generator Power (GP) reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Buy Generator 2.

steps.text: Complete your first Infinity, which gives you Infinity Points (IP).
Spend IP on Generator 2 in the Infinity layer.
steps.note: Generator 2 produces Generator 1.

achievements.summary: Complete Infinity Challenge 4, Steep Climbs.

steps.text: Finish Challenges 1, 2 and 3 first, since each completed challenge unlocks the next.
Start Challenge 4, where Prestige and Promote gains are raised to the power of 0.4.
Reach 1.79e308 Score and Infinite inside the challenge.
steps.note: This challenge can take several hours.

achievements.summary: Have 256 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Infinite repeatedly and save your IP until you hold 256 at once.

achievements.summary: Unlock Auto Prestige by buying Infinity Upgrade 5;3.

steps.text: Buy upgrades down the Infinity tree until you can afford Auto Prestige (5;3), which costs 3 Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Have 1,000 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Infinite repeatedly and save your IP until you hold 1,000 at once.

achievements.summary: Reach Infinity without using any Promotion.

steps.text: Do not promote at all during the run, then reach 1.79e308 Score and Infinite.
steps.note: Turn Auto Promote off.

achievements.summary: Reach 256 total Infinities.

steps.text: Infinite again and again until your Infinity count reaches 256.
steps.note: Auto Infinity (15;1) can do this for you.

achievements.summary: Break Infinity.

steps.text: Buy Infinity Upgrade 7;1 (Challenges!) to unlock the nine @mechanic{Infinity Challenges}.
Complete Challenges 1 to 9 in order by reaching Infinity while each handicap is active.
steps.note: Each finished challenge unlocks the next. Challenges 4 and 9 can take several hours.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Challenges} tab and choose to break Infinity.

achievements.summary: Have 50 achievements unlocked.

steps.text: Keep earning achievements until you own 50 in total.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1.8e3080.

steps.text: Complete the Infinity Challenges and break Infinity in the @loc{Challenges} tab.
Keep playing a run until your Score reaches 1.8e3080.
steps.note: Once Infinity is broken, the 10x IP bar fills at e3,080 Score and every further e308 Score gives another 10x IP.

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000,000 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} and growing your IP until you have 1,000,000 Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Reach 2,048 Infinities.

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity}. Each one adds 1 to your Infinity count.
steps.note: Infinity Upgrade 15;1 (Auto Infinity) unlocks automation that performs Infinities for you.

achievements.description: Get all challenges time sum < 10 minutes
achievements.summary: Get the best times of all nine Infinity Challenges to add up to under 10 minutes.

guide.context: Challenge times reset on Eternity until you have 3 Eternity Challenge completions.

steps.text: Complete all nine @mechanic{Infinity Challenges} at least once so each one shows a best time.
Replay challenges to lower their best times until the nine times add up to less than 10 minutes.
steps.note: Infinity Upgrade 19;3 (Challenge Efficiency) triples lap speed and helps you finish faster.

achievements.description: Get 1 Million IP in one infinity
achievements.summary: Gain 1,000,000 Infinity Points (IP) in a single Infinity.

steps.text: Buy upgrades that boost IP gain, such as Infinity Upgrades 15;2 (Fast IP Gain) and 16;1 (Infinity to IP).
Keep the run going before you Infinite until that one Infinity would give at least 1,000,000 IP.
steps.note: After Infinity is broken, every extra e308 Score above e3,080 multiplies that run's IP by 10.

achievements.summary: Buy the fifth Generator.

steps.text: Spend Infinity Points (IP) on @mechanic{Generators} until you own Generator 5.

achievements.summary: Have 1.00e15 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} and holding your IP until you have 1.00e15 (1 Qa) Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Reach 32,768 Infinities.

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity}, using automation and passive gain to speed it up.
steps.note: Infinity Upgrade 15;1 (Auto Infinity) unlocks Infinity automation, and 18;1 (Passive Infinities) adds Infinities over time.

achievements.summary: Raise your Generator Exponent to 1 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Infinity Upgrade 14;2 (Efficiency V), 19;1 (Almost one) and 20;2 (Dynamic Generator Exponent).
steps.note: The exponent starts at 0.666, and upgrades 14;2 and 19;1 lift its base to 0.75 and 0.9.

steps.text: Add more Generator Exponent boosts until it reaches 1: the Frog and Goose Animals (x1.1 each), the Gen. Power Exponent research upgrade (+0.02 per level) and the Eternity Challenge 4 reward.

achievements.summary: Reach level 1,000 on all four Promotions.

guide.context: Promotion levels reset on every Infinity, so all four must reach level 1,000 within one Infinity.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Promote} to raise Promotions 1, 2, 3 and 4 in rotation so all four climb evenly.
Repeat until every Promotion is at level 1,000.
steps.note: Infinity Upgrade 10;1 (Auto Work) automates Promotions.

achievements.summary: Unlock Stars.

steps.text: Buy Infinity Upgrade 21;1 (A Falling Star), which costs 1e33 Infinity Points (IP).
steps.note: Save 2e33 IP to afford your first Star right away.

achievements.summary: Get 1,000 Stardust.

steps.text: Buy a Star in the @loc{Stars} tab so it starts producing Stardust.
Wait until your Stardust reaches 1,000.
steps.note: Stardust resets to zero on every Infinity.

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000,000 Infinities.

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} and raise how many Infinities each one gives.
steps.note: The Infinity Gain Stardust upgrade adds +1x per purchase with no limit, and Infinity Upgrade 18;1 (Passive Infinities) adds Infinities over time.

achievements.summary: Reach Ascension 40 or higher on all ten colors.

guide.context: Colors and their Ascensions reset on every Infinity, so reach 40 on all colors within one run.

steps.text: Level each color to its cap, then ascend it. Repeat until every color from Red to White has 40 Ascensions.
steps.note: A color's level cap is 100 plus 10 per Ascension. Infinity Upgrade 2;2 (Auto Ascend) ascends for you.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e63 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} and growing your IP gain until you have 1.00e63 (1 Vg) Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e93 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} and growing your IP gain until you have 1.00e93 (1 Tg) Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.summary: Buy 16 Stars.

steps.text: Spend Infinity Points (IP) on Stars in the @loc{Stars} tab until you own 16.
steps.note: Each Star costs more than the last. Early ones rise by about 1e3 each time, later ones by 1e7 or more.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e154 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Keep performing @mechanic{Infinity} until you have 1.00e154 Infinity Points (IP).
steps.note: Buy Stars and Star Upgrades before Generators for faster growth.

achievements.summary: Go Eternal for the first time.

steps.text: Raise your Infinity Points (IP) to about 1.79e308.
Choose Eternate to claim 1 Eternity Point (EP).
steps.note: @mechanic{Eternity} resets your Infinity Upgrades, Generators, Infinity Challenge progress, Stars and Star Upgrades.

achievements.summary: Go Eternal twice.

steps.text: Raise your Infinity Points (IP) to about 1.79e308 again in your next run and choose Eternate.

achievements.summary: Buy your first Animal.

steps.text: Reach 3 Eternities to unlock the @loc{Animals} tab.
In the Animals tab, buy Animal Points (AP) with Eternity Points (EP), IP or Score.
Spend AP on an Animal. Cat costs 1 AP.

achievements.summary: Use Slowdown for the first time.

steps.text: Own at least 1 Animal to unlock Slowdown.
Raise every color above 10 laps per second.
Open the Slowdown menu from the lower-left corner of the @loc{Revolution} page, then click Slowdown inside it.
steps.note: Each Slowdown divides lap speed by 10 and adds 1 Ascension to every color.

achievements.summary: Go Eternal four times.

steps.text: Eternate four times in total, each time at about 1.79e308 Infinity Points (IP).

achievements.description: Go Eternal in under than 1 hour
achievements.summary: Complete an Eternity in under 1 hour.

steps.text: Unlock the Eternity automation: Infinity Upgrades at 12 Eternities, Generators at 14, and Stars plus Auto Eternity at 16.
Start a new Eternity and Eternate again within 1 hour.

achievements.summary: Unlock Eternity Challenges.

steps.text: Reach 8 Eternities (Eternity Milestone 6) to unlock the @loc{Eternity Challenges} tab.

achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 1 once.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Eternity Challenges} tab and start Eternity Challenge 1, which divides lap speed by 20.
Reach a Score of e30,000 while it is active.
steps.note: The reward is lap speed x2. Finishing a challenge also gives 1 free Animal Point (AP).

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000,000 Ascension Power.

steps.text: Raise Ascension Power with the Ascension Power Promotion, Infinity Upgrades 6;1, 6;2, 13;1 and 16;2, and the Ascend Power research upgrade.
steps.note: The Pheasant Animal (x2) and Eternity Challenge 5 also raise it.

achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 1 a second time at difficulty 2.

steps.text: Finish difficulty 1, then start difficulty 2 of Eternity Challenge 1, which divides lap speed by 128.
Reach the target Score of that challenge.
steps.note: Finishing difficulty 2 also unlocks Eternity Challenge 2.

achievements.summary: Break Eternity.

steps.text: Eternate until you reach 32 Eternities.
steps.note: At 32 Eternities, Infinity Points (IP) is no longer capped at about 1.79e308, and higher IP gives more Eternity Points (EP) per Eternity. Auto Eternity unlocks at 16 Eternities.

achievements.summary: Have 5 Eternity Challenge completions.

steps.text: Complete difficulties 1 to 3 of Eternity Challenge 1, then difficulties 1 and 2 of Eternity Challenge 2.
steps.note: Every difficulty of every challenge counts as one completion.

achievements.summary: Gain 4 Eternity Points (EP) from a single Eternity.

guide.context: A single Eternity gives only 1 EP until Eternity is broken.

steps.text: Break Eternity by reaching 32 Eternities.
Let your Infinity Points (IP) climb well past 1.79e308 before you Eternate. Repeat until one Eternity gives 4 EP.
steps.note: The Snake Animal (x2 EP) and the EP Gain research upgrade raise EP.

achievements.summary: Complete an Eternity in under 1 minute.

steps.text: Start a new Eternity and Eternate again within 60 seconds.
steps.note: With 20 Animals owned, every second you receive the full IP an Infinity would pay out. This needs 10 Eternity Challenge completions to work fully. IP-gain Animals such as Cat and Giraffe and the IP Gain research upgrade also help.

achievements.summary: Reach 100 Eternities.

steps.text: Eternate again and again. Each Eternate gives 1 Eternity.
steps.note: Auto Eternity unlocks at 16 Eternities.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e9 Infinities.

steps.text: Raise the Infinities gained per Infinity with the Infinity Gain Stardust upgrade, Infinity Upgrade 17;2 (Faster Infinity Gain) and the Eternity Infinity gain bonus.
Buy Infinity Upgrade 18;1 (Passive Infinities) so Infinities keep rising over time.

achievements.summary: Earn 1 Research Point (RP).

steps.text: Own 7 Animals to unlock the @loc{Laboratory}.
In the Laboratory, buy the Base, Mult and Power upgrades with Eternity Points (EP) to build Laboratory Points (LP).
When the flask fills, your Lab level rises and you gain 1 RP.

achievements.summary: Gain 10 Eternity Points (EP) from a single Eternity.

guide.context: A single Eternity gives only 1 EP until Eternity is broken.

steps.text: Break Eternity by reaching 32 Eternities.
Eternate with much more Infinity Points (IP) than 1.79e308 until one Eternity gives 10 EP.
steps.note: The Snake and Cow Animals and the EP Gain research upgrade raise EP.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 10 Research Points (RP).

steps.text: In the Laboratory, buy the Base, Mult and Power upgrades with Eternity Points (EP) so the flask fills faster.
steps.note: Each time the flask fills, your Lab level rises and you gain 1 Research Point (RP).

steps.text: Repeat until you have earned a total of 10 RP.

achievements.description: All RP upgrades have at least 1 lvl
achievements.summary: Put at least 1 level into all six research upgrades.

steps.text: Spend 1 Research Point (RP) on each research upgrade: IP Gain, Ascend Power, Star Base Mult, EP Gain, Gen. Power Exponent and Common Exponent.

achievements.description: All RP upgrades have at least 5 lvls
achievements.summary: Put at least 5 levels into all six research upgrades.

steps.text: Spend Research Points (RP) until each research upgrade is at level 5 or higher.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 1.

steps.text: Reach 8 Eternity Challenge completions (each difficulty of a challenge counts as one) to unlock the @loc{Supernova} tab.
Reach the Score a Supernova needs, then click Go Supernova.
steps.note: Each Supernova adds bonuses to Eternity rewards, Star Base, Lab Base, Eternity Point gain and Animal Points.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 2.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 2.
steps.note: Each Supernova adds bonuses to Eternity rewards, Star Base, Lab Base, Eternity Point gain and Animal Points.

achievements.description: All RP upgrades have at least 10 lvls
achievements.summary: Put at least 10 levels into all six research upgrades.

steps.text: Spend Research Points (RP) until each research upgrade is at level 10 or higher.

achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 4 once.

steps.text: Complete difficulty 2 of Eternity Challenges 1, 2 and 3 to unlock Challenge 4.
Start Eternity Challenge 4, which divides Generator Exponent by 10.
Reach a Score of e15,000 while it is active.
steps.note: The reward is Generator Exponent x1.03.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 3.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 3.
steps.note: Each Supernova adds bonuses to Eternity rewards, Star Base, Lab Base, Eternity Point gain and Animal Points.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 100 Research Points (RP).

steps.text: In the Laboratory, buy the Base, Mult and Power upgrades with Eternity Points (EP) so the flask fills faster.
steps.note: Each time the flask fills, your Lab level rises and you gain 1 Research Point (RP).

steps.text: Repeat until you have earned a total of 100 RP.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 5.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 5.
steps.note: Each Supernova adds bonuses to Eternity rewards, Star Base, Lab Base, Eternity Point gain and Animal Points.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e12 Eternity Points (EP).

steps.text: Break Eternity and keep Eternating with high Infinity Points (IP) so each Eternity pays out more EP.
Add EP multipliers: the Snake Animal, the EP Gain research upgrade and each Supernova.
steps.note: Each Supernova multiplies EP gain by x3.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e400 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Reach 32 Eternities (Σ). This lifts the cap of about 1.79e308 on Infinity Points.
Perform @mechanic{Infinity} again and again to collect IP until you reach 1.00e400.

achievements.displayName: Fifth Eternity Challenge is completed... Once
achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 5 once.

steps.text: Complete difficulty 2 of Eternity Challenge 4 to unlock Eternity Challenge 5.
Start Eternity Challenge 5 in the @loc{Eternity Challenges} tab and reach e60,000 Score with the ^0.10 Ascension Power handicap.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 6.

guide.context: The Supernova tab unlocks after you complete 8 Eternity Challenge difficulties.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 6.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 8.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 8.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 10.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 10.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 200 Research Points (RP).

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e1,000,000.

achievements.displayName: Supernova of the Dev's age at game's release

achievements.summary: Unlock the Dilation tab.

Spend AP on Animals until you own all 81. The Dilation tab unlocks.

achievements.summary: Buy the first Dilation Upgrade.

Spend Dilation Points (DP) on Dilation Upgrade 1 (it costs 500 DP).

achievements.summary: Reach Infinity while inside Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation in the @loc{Dilation} tab.
Raise your Score to 1.79e308, the point where the Infinity option appears.
Perform Infinity while you are still inside Dilation.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1.00e1,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation and raise your Score there to 1.00e1,000.
Buy Dilation Upgrade 1 to weaken the penalties.

achievements.summary: Get 1.00e9 Dilation Points (DP).

steps.text: Press Go Dilation in the @loc{Dilation} tab and raise your Score there.
Exit Dilation. This sets your Max Score, and DP income depends on it.
Buy Dilation Upgrade 2 to increase DP income.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1.00e10,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation and raise your Score there to 1.00e10,000.
Buy Dilation Upgrade 1 to weaken the penalties.

achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 10 once.

steps.text: Complete difficulty 2 of Eternity Challenge 9 to unlock Eternity Challenge 10.
Start Eternity Challenge 10 in the @loc{Eternity Challenges} tab and reach the goal shown for difficulty 1.

achievements.summary: Complete Eternity Challenge 10 twice.

steps.text: Complete difficulty 1 of Eternity Challenge 10 first.
Then complete difficulty 2 of Eternity Challenge 10.

achievements.description: Buy at least 1 of all 9 Dilation upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy at least one level of each of the 9 Dilation Upgrades.

achievements.displayName: Dilation is not as strong as before
achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e100,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation and raise your Score there to 1e100,000.
Dilation Upgrades 4 and 6 raise your Common Exponent and Generator Exponent.

achievements.summary: Complete all 50 Eternity Challenges.

guide.context: The sixth difficulty of each challenge needs Insane Trial 4 and is not required.

steps.text: Complete difficulties 1 to 5 of each of the 10 challenges in the @loc{Eternity Challenges} tab. Each challenge unlocks when difficulty 2 of the one before it is done.

achievements.summary: Buy your first Dilation Tree Point (DTP).

steps.text: Reach 1e27 DP.
Press Buy DTP in the @loc{Dilation Tree} tab.

achievements.description: Invest 2 DTP in center DT upgrade
achievements.summary: Put 2 Dilation Tree Points (DTP) into the center upgrade CENTER-1.

steps.text: Buy 2 DTP with Buy DTP.
Put both into CENTER-1, the green center tile.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e1,000,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation and raise your Score there to 1e1,000,000.
Dilation Upgrades 4 and 6 raise your Common Exponent and Generator Exponent.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 50.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press Go Supernova each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 50.

achievements.summary: Have 10,000 unspent Animal Points (AP).

steps.text: Buy AP with EP, IP and Score in the @loc{Animals} tab and leave it unspent.
Going Supernova adds 2 free AP each time.

achievements.summary: Buy a total of 5 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Keep pressing Buy DTP in the @loc{Dilation Tree} tab until you have bought 5.

achievements.displayName: A way to get more DP
achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e3,000,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go Dilation and raise your Score there to 1e3,000,000.
Dilation Upgrades 4 and 6 raise your Common Exponent and Generator Exponent.

achievements.description: Buy TOP-2, MID-2 or BOT-2 dilation tree upgrade
achievements.summary: Buy the TOP-2, MIDDLE-2 or BOTTOM-2 Dilation Tree upgrade.

steps.text: Put 1 DTP in CENTER-1, then 1 DTP in TOP-1, MIDDLE-1 or BOTTOM-1.
Put 1 DTP in the -2 upgrade of that same axis.

achievements.description: Respec Dilation Tree after buying 6+ DTP
achievements.summary: Respec the Dilation Tree after buying at least 6 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Buy at least 6 DTP in the @loc{Dilation Tree} tab.
Press the respec button (two arrows in a circle).

achievements.summary: Reach 10,000,000 Eternities.

guide.context: MIDDLE-2 needs the Dilation Tree, which unlocks after you complete all 50 Eternity Challenges.

Keep performing @mechanic{Eternity} resets to raise your Eternity count (Σ).

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e10,000,000 while in Dilation.

Dilation Upgrades 4 and 6 raise your Common Exponent and Generator Exponent.

steps.text: Keep pressing Buy DTP in the @loc{Dilation Tree} tab until you have 10.

achievements.description: Have at least 1 TOP-4, 1 MID-4 and 1 BOT-4 dilation tree upgrade
achievements.summary: Own a level of the TOP-4 upgrade, a level of the MIDDLE-4 upgrade and a level of the BOTTOM-4 upgrade in the Dilation Tree.

guide.context: This takes 13 DTP: 1 for CENTER-1 and 1 for each of the 12 upgrades on the three axes.

achievements.summary: Earn a total of 10,000 Research Points (RP).

steps.text: Spend Eternity Points on the Base, Mult and Power upgrades in the @loc{Laboratory} so the flask fills faster.
Going Supernova doubles your Lab Base.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Supernova} tab and press @loc{Go Supernova} each time your Score meets the requirement, until you reach Supernova 120.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e2,400 Eternity Points (EP).

steps.text: Eternate with as much IP as you can, since higher IP gives more EP.
Raise EP gain with Supernovae, Dilation Upgrade 7 and the EP Gain upgrade in the @loc{Laboratory}.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.80e308 Dilation Points (DP).

steps.text: Press Go/Exit Dilation in the @loc{Dilation} tab and raise your Score there.
Exit Dilation. This sets your Max Score, and DP income depends on it.
Buy Dilation Upgrade 2 to increase DP income.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of 1e50,000,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Press Go/Exit Dilation and raise your Score there to 1e50,000,000.
Dilation Upgrades 4 and 6 raise your Common Exponent and Generator Exponent.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 150.

steps.text: Press @loc{Go Supernova} in the @loc{Supernova} tab each time the requirement is met, until your count reaches 150.
steps.note: Wind zodiacs and Dilation Tree upgrade TOP-3 lower the Supernova score requirement.

achievements.displayName: We need a new BigNum library
achievements.summary: Reach a score of e200,000,000.

steps.text: Keep raising your score with Supernovae, Animal bonuses, Dilation Upgrade 4 and zodiacs that boost Common Exponent, until it reaches e200,000,000.

achievements.summary: Own 25 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Buy Dilation Tree Points with the @loc{Buy DTP} button in the Dilation Tree tab until you own 25.
steps.note: Buying uses Dilation Points (DP). The tab opens once all 50 Eternity Challenges are complete.

achievements.displayName: Halfway to buy the whole tree
achievements.summary: Own 33 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Buy Dilation Tree Points with the @loc{Buy DTP} button in the Dilation Tree tab until you own 33.
steps.note: Buying uses Dilation Points (DP). The tab opens once all 50 Eternity Challenges are complete.

achievements.displayName: Supernova as number of this achievement

steps.text: Press @loc{Go Supernova} in the @loc{Supernova} tab each time the requirement is met, until your count reaches 152.
steps.note: Wind zodiacs and Dilation Tree upgrade TOP-3 lower the Supernova score requirement.

achievements.displayName: Unity is in front of us
achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e2,433 Eternity Points (EP).

steps.note: Dilation Upgrade 7 multiplies EP gain.

achievements.displayName: We don't have to buy the whole tree to Unite
achievements.summary: Own 40 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.note: Buying uses Dilation Points (DP). The tab opens once all 50 Eternity Challenges are complete.

achievements.summary: Reach a score of e600,000,000.

steps.text: Keep raising your score with Supernovae, Animal bonuses, Dilation Upgrade 4 and zodiacs that boost Common Exponent, until it reaches e600,000,000.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 156.

steps.text: Press @loc{Go Supernova} in the @loc{Supernova} tab each time the requirement is met, until your count reaches 156.
steps.note: Wind zodiacs and Dilation Tree upgrade TOP-3 lower the Supernova score requirement.

achievements.summary: Reach 400,000 Animal Points (AP).

guide.context: Buying every Animal needs only 1,524 AP, so you must keep buying AP well after the Animals are done.

steps.text: Buy Animal Points in the Animals tab with EP, IP and Score until you reach 400,000.
steps.note: Each Supernova also adds 2 AP.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e1,000 Dilation Points (DP).

steps.text: Go into Dilation, push your score as high as you can, then exit to raise your Max Score.
Repeat until your DP reaches 1.00e1,000.
steps.note: DP income depends on Max Score. Unity count, Dilation Upgrade 2 and Dilation Tree upgrades boost it.

achievements.summary: Reach a score of e1,000,000,000.

steps.text: Keep raising your score with Supernovae, Animal bonuses, Dilation Upgrade 4 and zodiacs that boost Common Exponent, until it reaches e1,000,000,000.

steps.text: Keep going through Eternities until your EP reaches 1.08e2,466.
steps.note: Dilation Upgrade 7 multiplies EP gain. This is also the amount needed to Unite.

achievements.summary: Unite for the first time.

steps.text: Reach 1.08e2,466 Eternity Points (EP), then Unite and pick one of the zodiacs offered.

achievements.description: Equip a zodiac on a Sun
achievements.summary: Place a zodiac on the Sun planet.

steps.text: In the Astrology tab, assign one of your zodiacs to the @item{Sun} slot and confirm the Unity reset.

achievements.summary: Have at least 2 Unities.

steps.text: Reach 1.08e2,466 EP again and Unite a second time.

achievements.displayName: It took less than a day
achievements.summary: Perform a Unity in under 24 hours.

steps.text: Reach 1.08e2,466 EP and Unite while the time in the current Unity is below 24 hours.
steps.note: The Statistics tab shows the time in this Unity.

achievements.summary: Have 3 zodiacs equipped on planets.

steps.text: Put zodiacs on the Sun, Mercury and Venus slots in the Astrology tab.
steps.note: Mercury unlocks after you place a zodiac on the Sun. Venus unlocks at 2 Unities.

achievements.summary: Complete one Easy Trial.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Trials} tab, lock Easy Trial 1, then click the blue reset button.
Reach Infinity while buying only the first 6 colors, then unlock the trial again.

achievements.summary: Complete 3 trials.

steps.text: Complete any three trials in the @loc{Trials} tab, such as Easy Trials 1 to 3.
steps.note: Lock a trial, click the blue reset button, finish its goal, then unlock it again.

achievements.summary: Have 5 Unities.

steps.text: Unite again until your Unity count reaches 5.
steps.note: Each Unity needs 1.08e2,466 EP.

achievements.summary: Have 10 Unities.

steps.text: Unite again until your Unity count reaches 10.
steps.note: Each Unity needs 1.08e2,466 EP.

achievements.summary: Complete all 6 Easy Trials.

guide.context: Handicaps: Trial 1 allows the first 6 colors only. Trial 2 blocks Promotions 3 and 4. Trial 3 multiplies Common Exponent by 0.6. Trial 4 blocks Promotions 2 and 4 and Prestige. Trial 5 caps Common Exponent at 0.7. Trial 6 blocks Prestige, Promote and Ascend.

steps.text: Complete Easy Trials 1 to 6 in the @loc{Trials} tab by reaching Infinity under each trial's handicap.
steps.note: Lock a trial, click the blue reset button, finish it, then unlock it again.

achievements.summary: Go Supernova while you have 0 Eternities.

steps.text: Press @loc{Go Supernova} in the @loc{Supernova} tab while your Eternity count shows 0.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 5 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Unite and pick a zodiac that is level 5 or higher.
steps.note: Zodiac level rises with Zodiac Exp from completed trials, Unities, Supernova count, Eternity count and DTP count.

achievements.summary: Complete one Medium Trial.

steps.text: In the @loc{Trials} tab, lock a Medium Trial, click the blue reset button, and reach Eternity under its handicap.
steps.note: Medium Trials open once all Easy Trials are done. Medium Trial 1 allows only the first two Infinity Generators.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.00e13 Eternities.

steps.text: Unite once so more than 1 Eternity can be gained per Eternate.
steps.note: This is only possible after your first Unity.

steps.text: Keep Eternating to raise your Eternity count to 1.00e13.
steps.note: Unity count and Dilation Tree MIDDLE-2 raise how many Eternities you gain.

steps.note: Wind zodiacs and Dilation Tree upgrade TOP-3 lower the Supernova score requirement.

achievements.summary: Reach a score of e2,000,000,000.

steps.note: Buying uses Dilation Points (DP). The tab opens once all 50 Eternity Challenges are complete.

steps.note: Each Supernova also adds 2 AP.

steps.note: Dilation Upgrade 1 weakens the Dilation penalties.

achievements.summary: Reach a score of e3,000,000,000.

steps.text: Keep raising your score with Supernovae, Animal bonuses, Dilation Upgrade 4 and zodiacs that boost Common Exponent, until it reaches e3,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 10 or higher through Unity.

steps.note: Zodiac level rises with Zodiac Exp from completed trials, Unities, Supernova count, Eternity count and DTP count.

achievements.summary: Get a zodiac of Legendary rarity or higher.

achievements.summary: Reach a score of e10,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 20 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Unite and pick a zodiac that is level 20 or higher.
steps.note: Zodiac level rises with Zodiac Exp from completed trials, Unities, Supernova count, Eternity count and DTP count.

steps.text: Complete Medium Trials 1 to 6 in the @loc{Trials} tab by reaching Eternity under each handicap.
steps.note: Lock a trial, click the blue reset button, finish it, then unlock it again.

achievements.summary: Buy 60 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Buy Dilation Tree Points with the @loc{Buy DTP} button in the Dilation Tree tab until you own 60.
steps.note: Buying uses Dilation Points (DP). The tab opens once all 50 Eternity Challenges are complete.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 40 or higher through Unity.

steps.note: Zodiac level rises with Zodiac Exp from completed trials, Unities, Supernova count, Eternity count and DTP count.

steps.text: Finish all 6 Easy Trials and all 6 Medium Trials in the @loc{Trials} tab.
Complete 3 Hard Trials, which ask you to reach Unity under a handicap.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 1.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Attacks} tab and let the Attack Circles hit the enemy until its HP bar is empty.
steps.note: Click a circle's button to level it up with Gold.

achievements.description: Merge 3 Goldy Zodiacs to Divine (Or get Divine+ zodiac on Unity)
achievements.summary: Merge 3 Godly zodiacs into a Divine zodiac, or get a Divine or higher zodiac when you Unite.

Raise your Luck, for example with the Luck donut, and Unite until you hold 3 Godly zodiacs of the same element.

steps.text: Merge the 3 Godly zodiacs to make a Divine zodiac.
steps.note: Merging needs 3 zodiacs of the same element and rarity.

steps.text: Level up the Attack Circles with Gold and keep fighting in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Level 20.

steps.note: Relic 1, Silver Coin, unlocks at Attack Level 1.

achievements.summary: Buy 5 Relic levels in total.

achievements.summary: Own at least Lv.1 of each of the first three Relics.

steps.note: They unlock at Attack Levels 1, 10 and 20.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 50.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Attack Level 50.
steps.note: Uniting and picking a Zodiac resets Attack Level to 0.

achievements.summary: Buy the second Attack Circle (color).

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level, then Unite to collect Gold.

achievements.description: Generate less than 0.05 lab pts/s, but more than 0.01 lab pts/s
achievements.summary: Have between 0.01 and 0.05 laboratory points per second.

guide.context: The @loc{Laboratory} tab unlocks at Animals Milestone 3, which needs 7 Animals.

steps.text: Buy Base, Mult and Power upgrades with Eternity Points (EP) in the @loc{Laboratory} until the rate is above 0.01 and below 0.05, then stop buying.
steps.note: @warn{Each level raises the rate, so extra purchases can push it past 0.05.} Rate = (Base x Mult) ^ Power; each level adds 0.20 to Base, 0.50 to Mult and 0.01 to Power.

achievements.summary: Unlock all of the first 200 achievements in the game's list (achievements 1 to 200).

steps.text: Finish every achievement numbered 1 to 200 in the achievement list.
steps.note: Inefficiently Efficient, the laboratory rate achievement, is part of this set.

achievements.summary: Own the first six Relics.

steps.text: Buy 1 level each of Relics 1 to 6 in the @loc{Relics} tab.
steps.note: Relic 6, Rusty Silver Sword, unlocks at Attack Level 50.

achievements.summary: Buy the third Attack Circle (color).

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level, then Unite to collect Gold.
In the @loc{Attacks} tab, buy the third circle, Burnt Umber, with Gold (base cost 1000).

achievements.summary: Hold at least 10,000 Gold.

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level, then Unite to collect the Gold shown at the bottom of the @loc{Attacks} screen.
Keep going until the larger Gold number on that screen, your total, reaches 10,000.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 50 or higher through Unity.

guide.context: A Zodiac's level comes from Zodiac Exp. Exp grows with factors such as cleared Trials, Unities, EP, Score, Supernovae and the Zodiac Exp. Factor donut in the @loc{Planet Shop}.

steps.text: Keep raising Zodiac Exp and Unite until a Zodiac of level 50 or higher is offered, then pick it.

achievements.displayName: Do you feel how it became slower?
achievements.summary: Reach a Score of e30,000,000,000.

steps.text: Improve your Zodiacs, Planet bonuses and Unity count to push your Score up until it reaches e30,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 69 through Unity.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Exp by clearing more Trials, Uniting more often, and growing your EP, Score and Supernovae. Buying the Zodiac Exp. Factor donut in the @loc{Planet Shop} adds another factor.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Lv.69, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Reach Supernova 200.

steps.text: Press @loc{Go Supernova} in the @loc{Supernova} tab each time your Score reaches the requirement, until your count is 200.
steps.note: Wind zodiacs and Dilation Tree upgrade TOP-3 lower the requirement.

achievements.summary: Have 65 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

steps.text: Unlock the Dilation Tree tab by completing all 50 Eternity Challenges.
Earn Dilation Points (DP) by playing in @mechanic{Dilation}.
Press Buy DTP in the Dilation Tree tab whenever you can afford it, until you have 65 DTP.
steps.note: The first DTP appears at 1e27 DP.

achievements.summary: Buy the fifth Attack Circle (color).

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level, then Unite to collect Gold.
In the @loc{Attacks} tab, buy the fifth circle, Dark Lava, with Gold (base cost 1e9).

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of e50,000,000,000.

steps.text: Improve your Zodiacs, Planet bonuses and Unity count to push your Score up until it reaches e50,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 256.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Attack Level 256.

achievements.summary: Hold at least 10,000,000 astrodust.

steps.text: Complete Easy Trial 6 to unlock the @loc{Planet Shop}.
Put a Zodiac in the sell slot of the Planet Shop, then press Sell for X to get astrodust.
Keep selling Zodiacs until you hold 10,000,000 astrodust.
steps.note: Spending astrodust on donuts lowers your total.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice a Zodiac for the first time.

steps.text: In the @loc{Planet Shop}, unlock Sacrificing for 10,000,000 astrodust. The Shop opens after Easy Trial 6.
Put a Zodiac into Sacrificing and sacrifice it.

achievements.summary: Buy 100 levels of Relic 10.

steps.text: Buy 100 levels of Rusty Car Engine in the @loc{Relics} tab.
steps.note: Relic 10 unlocks at Attack Level 150.

achievements.summary: Reach 1 year of playtime.

steps.text: Keep playing until the playtime on the Statistics screen shows 1 year.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice 10 Zodiacs.

steps.text: Complete Easy Trial 6 to unlock the @loc{Planet Shop}.
In the Planet Shop, unlock Sacrificing for 10,000,000 astrodust, which you earn by selling Zodiacs.
Put a Zodiac into Sacrificing and sacrifice it, until you have sacrificed 10 Zodiacs.
steps.note: The Unity page of Statistics counts how many you have sacrificed.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of e50,000,000,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Unlock Dilation by owning all 81 Animals.
Enter @mechanic{Dilation} with the Go/Exit Dilation button in the Dilation tab.
Play until your Score in Dilation reaches e50,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 100 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Exp by clearing more Trials, Uniting more often, and growing your EP, Score and Supernovae. Buying the Zodiac Exp. Factor donut in the @loc{Planet Shop} adds another factor.
Unite until a Zodiac of level 100 or higher is offered, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Get an Immortal Zodiac through Unity.

steps.text: Raise your Luck to about 550 to 600 or more.
steps.note: Luck comes from the Luck donut in the @loc{Planet Shop}, Relic 4 (Four Leaf Clover), planet Luck bonuses, Pisces and Scorpio.

steps.text: Unite and pick the Immortal Zodiac when it is offered.

achievements.summary: Complete Hard Trial 5.

steps.text: Beat all Medium Trials to unlock the Hard Trials.
Lock Hard Trial 5, then start it with the top-right blue reset button.
Reach Unity while keeping to the trial's limits: 50 of each Dilation upgrade and 2 DTP.
steps.note: Unlock the trial again after you complete it.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 102 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Exp by clearing more Trials, Uniting more often, and growing your EP, Score and Supernovae. Buying the Zodiac Exp. Factor donut in the @loc{Planet Shop} adds another factor.
Unite until a Zodiac of level 102 or higher is offered, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of e100,000,000,000.

steps.text: Improve your Zodiacs, Planet bonuses and Unity count to push your Score up until it reaches e100,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Ascend the fifth Attack Circle (color).

steps.text: In the @loc{Attacks} tab, raise the fifth circle, Dark Lava, to its max level of 20.
Press the A on the left of its circle button to ascend it.

achievements.summary: Own 5 levels of Relic 15.

steps.text: Buy 5 levels of Comfortable Telescope in the @loc{Relics} tab.
steps.note: Relic 15 unlocks at Attack Level 400.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 420.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Attack Level 420.
steps.note: Relic 16, Cool Glasses, unlocks at this level.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of e100,000,000,000 while in Dilation.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Dilation} with the Go/Exit Dilation button in the Dilation tab.
Play until your Score in Dilation reaches e100,000,000,000.

achievements.summary: Break Unity by completing all six Hard Trials.

guide.context: Hard Trial limits. 1: at most 20 Dilation Tree Points (DTP). 2: no Lab or Research Point upgrades. 3: no Supernova. 4: at most 1500 Animal Points and no going past Supernova 10. 5: at most 50 of each Dilation upgrade and 2 DTP. 6: no Dilation and no Eternity Challenges.

steps.text: Lock a Hard Trial, then start it with the top-right blue reset button.
Reach Unity within that trial's limits.
Unlock the trial after completing it, then do the next one until all six are done.
steps.note: Hard Trials open after all Medium Trials are beaten.

achievements.displayName: It wasn't difficult at all now
achievements.summary: Reach 1e3,000 Eternity Points (EP).

steps.text: Complete all six Hard Trials to Break Unity.
Keep gaining EP beyond 1.08e2466 until you reach 1e3,000.

achievements.description: Try with a full-fire build (all 12 planet slots are with only fire zodiacs) and reach e5e11 score
achievements.summary: With all 12 planet slots holding only fire Zodiacs, reach a Score of e500,000,000,000.

steps.text: Unlock all 12 planets, including Chiron (Lv.50 Zodiac) and Fortune Pars (Lv.100 Zodiac).
Put a fire Zodiac (Aries, Leo or Sagittarius) on every planet and confirm the Unity reset each time.
Play until your Score reaches e500,000,000,000.

achievements.description: Try with a full-earth build (all 12 planet slots are with only earth zodiacs) and reach 1.1e111 infinities, e350,000 IP and e6,200,000 Gen.Power Mult Gain
achievements.summary: With all 12 planet slots holding only earth Zodiacs, get the Generator Power bonus to Mult Gain (Gen.Power Mult Gain) to e6,200,000 while holding 1.10e111 Infinities and e350,000 Infinity Points (IP).

steps.text: Unlock all 12 planets, including Chiron (Lv.50 Zodiac) and Fortune Pars (Lv.100 Zodiac).
Put an earth Zodiac (Taurus, Virgo or Capricorn) on every planet and confirm the Unity reset each time.
Play until the Generator Power bonus to Mult Gain (Gen.Power Mult Gain) hits e6,200,000 while you hold 1.10e111 Infinities and e350,000 IP.

achievements.displayName: I feel it in the wind, my dear
achievements.description: Try with a full-wind build (all 12 planet slots are with only wind zodiacs) and reach 1e36 eternities and 1e45000 DP
achievements.summary: With all 12 planet slots holding only wind Zodiacs, have 1.00e45,000 Dilation Points (DP) and 1.00e36 Eternities.

steps.text: Unlock all 12 planets, including Chiron (Lv.50 Zodiac) and Fortune Pars (Lv.100 Zodiac).
Put a wind Zodiac (Gemini, Libra or Aquarius) on every planet and confirm the Unity reset each time.
Play until you have 1.00e45,000 DP and 1.00e36 Eternities.

achievements.description: Try with a full-water build (all 12 planet slots are with only water zodiacs) and get an immortal+5 zodiac with 1M+ quality
achievements.summary: With all 12 planet slots holding only water Zodiacs, get an Immortal+5 Zodiac with at least 1,000,000 quality through Unity.

steps.text: Unlock all 12 planets, including Chiron (Lv.50 Zodiac) and Fortune Pars (Lv.100 Zodiac).
Put a water Zodiac (Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces) on every planet and confirm the Unity reset each time.
Earn Best Rarity first, then raise Luck to at least 1659 so Immortal+5 can appear.
Raise Zodiac quality with the Quality donut and Enhancing in the @loc{Planet Shop}, and with Relic 2 (Pinewood Bracelet).
Unite and pick the Immortal+5 Zodiac once it is offered with 1,000,000 or more quality.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of level 110 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Exp by clearing more Trials, Uniting more often, and growing your EP, Score and Supernovae. Buying the Zodiac Exp. Factor donut in the @loc{Planet Shop} adds another factor.
Unite until a Zodiac of level 110 or higher is offered, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Reach 1,000 years of playtime.

steps.text: Keep playing until the playtime on the Statistics screen shows 1,000 years.

achievements.summary: Reach a Luck of 2,025 or more.

steps.text: Raise your Luck to 2,025 or more.
steps.note: Luck comes from the Luck donut in the @loc{Planet Shop}, Relic 4 (Four Leaf Clover), planet Luck bonuses, Pisces and Scorpio.

achievements.summary: Earn all four element full-build achievements: fire, earth, wind and water.

steps.text: Earn Dance of Fire and Flames (fire), Growing Mountains (earth), Swimming with sharks (water) and the wind build, @item{I feel it in the wind} (its full title ends with ", my dear").

achievements.description: Get a zodiac with Immortal+7 rarity or higher
achievements.summary: Unite and get a Zodiac of Immortal+7 rarity or better.

steps.text: Earn Best Rarity first so extra Immortal rarities can appear.
Raise your Luck to at least 2567.
Unite and pick the Immortal+7 Zodiac when it is offered.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 1,000.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Attack Level 1,000.
steps.note: Relic 20, Magestic Halberd, unlocks at this level.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 1,337.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in the @loc{Attacks} tab until you reach Attack Level 1,337.
steps.note: This unlocks the Minerals sub-tab in the Unity tab.

achievements.summary: Spawn a Level 1 Mineral.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Minerals} sub-tab in the Unity tab and spawn a Mineral with Gold. Level 1 is Paper.

achievements.description: Merge two Minerals and get a new Level+1 Mineral
achievements.summary: Combine two matching Minerals into a new Mineral of Level 1 or higher.

steps.text: Spawn two Level 1 Minerals with Gold in the @loc{Minerals} sub-tab.
Drag one Mineral onto the matching Mineral of the same level.

achievements.summary: Spawn a Level 5 Mineral.

steps.text: Raise the base mineral level with a Value Points (VP) upgrade in the @loc{Minerals} sub-tab.
Spawn Minerals until a Level 5 Mineral, called Stick, appears.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 22 for the first time.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 1,400 to unlock @item{Relic 22} (Nice easel).
Spend Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab to buy one level of @item{Relic 22}.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000,000 Value Points (VP).

guide.context: Minerals unlock once you reach Attack Level 1,337.

steps.text: Spawn Minerals with Gold and merge two matching Minerals into a higher-level one.
Wait until you hold 1,000,000 VP.

achievements.summary: Spawn a Level 10 Mineral.

steps.text: Buy levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP to raise the base mineral level.
Spawn a Mineral once the base mineral level is 10.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of Immortal+15 rarity by Uniting.

steps.text: Raise your Luck to at least 9962.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Immortal+15 or better.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000,000,000 (1e9) Value Points (VP).

steps.text: Merge Minerals into higher levels so they make more VP each second.
Wait until you hold 1e9 VP.

achievements.summary: Spawn a Level 15 Mineral.

steps.text: Keep buying levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP to raise the base mineral level.
Spawn a Mineral once the base mineral level is 15.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice a Relic.

steps.text: Buy levels of one Relic with Gold until it reaches level 301.
Sacrifice that Relic.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 2025.

guide.context: Uniting with a new Zodiac resets Attack Level to 0.

steps.text: Level up and Ascend your Attack Circles to beat enemies, and buy Relics that boost attacks, until the Attack Level reaches 2025.

achievements.summary: Perform a Polish Prestige.

guide.context: A Polish Prestige clears your VP, Minerals, every Mineral upgrade, Magnets and Merge Level, and pays out Polish Points (PP) to spend on the weapons.

steps.text: Merge Minerals until you have a Level 30 Mineral.
Perform the Polish Prestige.

achievements.summary: Reach Polish Sword Level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Polish Prestige to earn Polish Points (PP).
Spend PP on the Sword in the Polish tab until it reaches Level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.08e308 Gold.

steps.text: Push your Attack Level as high as you can before each Unite, because Uniting pays out Gold.
Raise Gold gain with @item{Relic 9}, @item{Relic 17} and @item{Relic 21}, and with the Polish Spear.

achievements.summary: Perform an Attacks Prestige.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 2025 to unlock Attacks Prestige.
Perform the Attacks Prestige.

achievements.displayName: No more annoying need to infinite
achievements.summary: Reach Polish Axe Level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Earn Polish Points (PP) with Polish Prestige.
Spend PP on the Axe in the Polish tab until it reaches Level 10.

achievements.summary: Get a Level 40 Mineral.

steps.text: Merge matching Minerals upward until you hold a Level 40 @item{Tantalum}.

achievements.summary: Reach Polish Spear Level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Earn Polish Points (PP) with Polish Prestige.
Spend PP on the Spear in the Polish tab until it reaches Level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 2,250.

steps.text: Level up and Ascend your Attack Circles and buy attack Relics until the Attack Level reaches 2,250.

achievements.summary: Get a Level 50 Mineral.

steps.text: Merge matching Minerals upward until you hold a Level 50 @item{Aetherium}.

achievements.description: Buy Relic 25 for the first time
achievements.summary: Buy Relic 25 for the first time.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 2,300 to unlock @item{Relic 25} (Lucky Luck Crystal).
Spend Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab to buy one level of @item{Relic 25}.

achievements.summary: Reach Polish Sword Level 50 or higher.

steps.text: Spend Polish Points (PP) on the Sword in the Polish tab until it reaches Level 50.
Keep performing Polish Prestiges to earn more PP.

achievements.description: Get 2nd milestones for all polish weapons
achievements.summary: Reach the second milestone on every Polish weapon: Sword, Axe, Spear, Bow and Knuckles.

steps.text: Spend Polish Points (PP) in the Polish tab to raise the Sword, Axe, Spear, Bow and Knuckles each to Level 25.

achievements.summary: Reach Mineral Level 60.

steps.text: Merge matching Minerals upward until you hold a Level 60 Mineral.

achievements.description: Get a zodiac with rarity Immortal+50 or better
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of Immortal+50 rarity or better by Uniting.

steps.text: Raise your Luck far above the amount needed for Immortal+19, which is 16959.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Immortal+50 or better.

achievements.description: Get a zodiac with rarity Immortal+100 or better
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of Immortal+100 rarity or better by Uniting.

steps.text: Raise your Luck well past 16959, the minimum for Immortal+19, because Immortal+100 needs more Luck than that.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Immortal+100 or better.

achievements.summary: Complete Insane Trial 1.

steps.text: Raise the Polish Knuckles to Level 25 to unlock Insane Trial 1.
Lock the trial in the @loc{Trials} tab, then press the blue reset button.
Open the @loc{Dilation Tree} tab and press @mechanic{Buy DTP}, paid with Dilation Points (DP), until you have bought 65 Dilation Tree Points (DTP).

achievements.summary: Complete Insane Trial 2.

steps.text: Finish Insane Trial 1 and raise the Polish Spear to Level 50 to unlock Insane Trial 2.
Lock the trial, press the blue reset button, and Unite with a score of e5,800,000 or more.

achievements.summary: Merge a Level 69 Mineral.

steps.text: Merge two Level 68 Minerals to make a Level 69 Mineral.

achievements.summary: Perform a Refine Prestige.

guide.context: A Refine Prestige clears your Polish upgrades, Merge Level, Magnets, Mineral upgrades, Minerals and VP, and pays out Refine Points (RfP) to spend in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Merge Minerals until you have a Level 70 Mineral.
Perform the Refine Prestige.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Nodes 2 and 3.

steps.text: Perform a Refine Prestige to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the @loc{Refine Tree} to buy @mechanic{Refine Node 2} and @mechanic{Refine Node 3}.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 1.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 5} in the Refine Tree to unlock Merge Level.
Keep merging Common Minerals until Merge Level hits 1.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 5.

steps.text: Keep merging Common Minerals until Merge Level hits 5.

achievements.summary: Raise Refine Node 4 to at least Level 2.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the @loc{Refine Tree} on @mechanic{Refine Node 4} until it is Level 2 or higher.

achievements.displayName: Just as eagerly awaited as August 14, 2025
achievements.description: Try automerge for the first time
achievements.summary: Use Automerge for the first time.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 6} in the Refine Tree.
Turn on Automerge Minerals in the automation settings.

achievements.summary: Raise Refine Node 1 to at least Level 2.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the @loc{Refine Tree} on @mechanic{Refine Node 1} until it is Level 2 or higher.

achievements.description: Have at least 1 Level in first 8 Refine Nodes
achievements.summary: Have at least Level 1 in each of Refine Nodes 1 to 8.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the @loc{Refine Tree} to buy each of @mechanic{Refine Node 1} through @mechanic{Refine Node 8} at least once.

achievements.description: Get 1.08e308 Attacks Mult. Gain from Attacks Prestige
achievements.summary: Perform an Attacks Prestige that grants at least 1.08e308 Attacks Mult. Gain.

steps.text: Raise your Attack Multipliers by letting the Attack Circles complete many laps.
Perform Attacks Prestige when its Attacks Mult. Gain reaches 1.08e308.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 28 for the first time.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 3,060 to unlock @item{Relic 28} (Two Souls).
Spend Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab to buy one level of @item{Relic 28}.

achievements.summary: Merge a Level 100 or higher Mineral.

steps.text: Merge two Level 99 Minerals to make a Level 100 Mineral.

achievements.summary: Have at least 10 Magnets.

guide.context: Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige reset your Magnets.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 18} in the Refine Tree to unlock Magnets.
Merge Minerals until you hold 10 Magnets.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1.08e308 Value Points (VP).

steps.text: Merge Minerals into the highest levels you can so they make more VP each second.
Wait until you hold 1.08e308 VP.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 21.

steps.text: Earn Refine Points (RfP) with Refine Prestige.
Spend RfP in the @loc{Refine Tree} to buy @mechanic{Refine Node 21}.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000 Magnets.

guide.context: Magnets reset on Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige and are spent on Magnet upgrades.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 18} in the Refine Tree to unlock Magnets, then merge Minerals to gain them.
Avoid spending Magnets until you hold 1,000.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 50.

guide.context: Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige reset Merge Level, so reach 50 within one run.

steps.text: Keep merging Common Minerals until Merge Level hits 50.

achievements.summary: Spawn a Mineral of Level 125 or higher.

steps.text: Buy levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP to raise the base mineral level.
Spawn a Mineral once the base mineral level is 125 or higher.

achievements.summary: Raise Refine Node 16 to at least Level 10.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the @loc{Refine Tree} on @mechanic{Refine Node 16} until it is Level 10 or higher.

achievements.summary: Raise Refine Node 1 to at least Level 7.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the @loc{Refine Tree} on @mechanic{Refine Node 1} until it is Level 7 or higher.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 69.

guide.context: Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige reset Merge Level, so reach 69 within one run.

steps.text: Keep merging Common Minerals until Merge Level hits 69.

achievements.summary: Complete Insane Trial 4.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Insane Trial 3} first. Insane Trials go in order.
Raise the Polish Axe to Lv.100 in the Polish tab to unlock Insane Trial 4.
Lock Insane Trial 4, then reset Unity to start it.
Reach 2.018e705 Eternity Points (EP) and 8.14e2025 Infinity Points (IP) inside the trial.
Unlock the trial again once it is done.

achievements.summary: Have 60 or more Eternity Challenge (EC) completions.

steps.text: Complete Insane Trial 4 to unlock the sixth difficulty of every Eternity Challenge.
Complete every difficulty of all 10 Eternity Challenges.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 30 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until you have bought @mechanic{Refine Node 30}.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 100 or higher.

guide.context: Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige reset Merge Level, so reach 100 within one run.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 5} to unlock Merge Level.
Merge pairs of common minerals to gain Merge Experience.
Keep merging until your Merge Level reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1.00e2500 Gold.

guide.context: Relics and mineral spawns spend Gold, so stop buying them once you are close to the target.

steps.text: Earn Gold by reaching a high Attack Level, then Unite to collect it.
Raise gold gain with the Polish Spear, the Gold Gain Mineral Upgrade and Yellow Gem Special Minerals until you hold 1.00e2500 Gold.

achievements.summary: Get your first Sun Rune.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 35} to unlock Runes.
Wait for the first Sun Rune to generate. The base rate is one every 10 days, and faster game speed shortens the wait.

achievements.summary: Get your first Moon Rune.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 35} to unlock Runes.
Wait for the first Moon Rune to generate. The base rate is one every 10 days, and faster game speed shortens the wait.

achievements.summary: Have a Magnet Chance of 10% or more.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 18} to unlock Magnets. The base Magnet Chance is 1%.
Level the Magnet Chance Mult upgrade in Mineral Upgrades until the chance reaches 10%.
More Magnet Chance comes from the Sun Rune Magnet Chance upgrade and Orange Gem Special Minerals.

achievements.description: Have x1,08e308+ gold gain bonus from Mineral Upgrade
achievements.summary: Have a gold gain bonus of x1.08e308 or more from the Gold Gain Mineral Upgrade.

steps.text: Open Mineral Upgrades in the Minerals tab.
Spend Value Points (VP) on the Gold Gain upgrade until its bonus reaches x1.08e308.

achievements.summary: Get a mineral of Level 150 or higher.

steps.text: Merge two identical minerals to make one of the next level.
Keep merging, and buy levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP to raise the base mineral level, until you hold a Level 150 mineral.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 40 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until you have bought @mechanic{Refine Node 40}.

achievements.description: Have both 10+ Sun and 10+ Moon Runes
achievements.summary: Have at least 10 Sun Runes and at least 10 Moon Runes.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 35} to unlock Runes.
Let both rune types generate. Spend early Runes on Generation Rate and Generation Amount upgrades to speed this up.
Wait until you have 10 of each Rune type at once.

achievements.description: Make your sun rune generation and moon rune generation be ≥ 2
achievements.summary: Have Sun Rune generation at 2 or more and Moon Rune generation at 2 or more.

steps.text: Open the Runes tab, which @mechanic{Refine Node 35} unlocks.
Buy the Generation Amount upgrade for Sun Runes and for Moon Runes. Each level adds 1.

achievements.summary: Spawn your first Special Mineral.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 41} to unlock the Special Minerals grid in the Minerals tab.
Gather 10 Runes of each type, Sun and Moon.
With the Special Minerals grid selected, press Spawn.

achievements.summary: Merge two identical Special Minerals.

guide.context: Merges before Refine Node 46 do not count toward Special Minerals Progression.

steps.text: Spawn two Special Minerals of the same type.
Drag one onto the other.

achievements.summary: Reach Special Mineral Level 3 or higher.

steps.text: Merge two Level 1 Special Minerals of the same type to make Level 2.
Merge two Level 2 Special Minerals of that type to make Level 3.

achievements.description: Have 9 different Special Minerals of each type
achievements.summary: Have 9 Special Minerals of each Special Mineral type.

steps.text: Buy levels of @mechanic{Refine Node 44} to enlarge the Special Minerals grid.
Spawn Special Minerals until you own 9 of every type.

achievements.summary: Have a Magnet Chance of 20% or more.

steps.text: Keep leveling the Magnet Chance Mult upgrade in Mineral Upgrades.
Add the Sun Rune Magnet Chance upgrade and Orange Gem Special Minerals until the chance reaches 20%.

achievements.displayName: Number of Limit is in it's number
achievements.description: Ok, fine, have 1,08e308+ Fall Speed from Mineral Upgrade
achievements.summary: Have a Fall Speed of 1.08e308 or more from the Fall Speed Mineral Upgrade.

steps.text: Open Mineral Upgrades in the Minerals tab.
Spend Value Points (VP) on the Fall Speed upgrade until its value reaches 1.08e308.

achievements.summary: Complete Insane Trial 5.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Insane Trial 4} first. Insane Trials go in order.
Raise the Polish Bow to Lv.100 in the Polish tab to unlock Insane Trial 5.
Lock Insane Trial 5, then reset Unity to start it.
Buy DTP with the Buy DTP button in the Dilation Tree tab until you reach 65.
steps.note: In this trial the first Dilation Upgrade is off, and Dilation penalties and Dilation gain are much harsher.

steps.text: Unlock the trial again once it is done.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 45 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until you have bought @mechanic{Refine Node 45}.

achievements.description: Get 1 exp in any of SMP
achievements.summary: Gain 1 experience in the Special Minerals Progression (SMP) of any Special Mineral.

guide.context: Merges done before Refine Node 46 add no SMP experience.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 46} to unlock Special Minerals Progression.
Spawn two Special Minerals of the same type and merge them.

achievements.description: Have both 100+ Sun and 100+ Moon Runes
achievements.summary: Have at least 100 Sun Runes and at least 100 Moon Runes.

guide.context: Spawning Special Minerals and buying rune upgrades spend Runes, so save them near the target.

steps.text: Keep both rune types generating, and speed them up with the Generation Rate and Generation Amount upgrades.
Hold 100 Sun Runes and 100 Moon Runes together.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1.00e100 Polish Points (PP).

guide.context: Spending PP on weapons lowers the PP you hold.

steps.text: Do Polish Prestige with a high mineral level to earn PP.
Repeat Polish Prestige, reaching higher mineral levels each time, until you hold 1.00e100 PP.

achievements.summary: Unlock every milestone on all five Polish weapons.

guide.context: Polish upgrades reset on Refine Prestige.

steps.text: Spend Polish Points (PP) in the Polish tab on the Sword, Axe, Spear, Bow and Knuckles.
Raise every weapon through Lv.10, Lv.25, Lv.50 and Lv.100.

achievements.summary: Complete Insane Trial 6.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Insane Trial 5} first. Insane Trials go in order.
Raise the Polish Knuckles to Lv.100 in the Polish tab to unlock Insane Trial 6.
Lock Insane Trial 6, then reset Unity to start it.
Reach Attack Level 100 inside the trial.
steps.note: Attack scaling is harsher here, Relic 13 is inverted, and Attack stats are wiped on Unity.

steps.text: Unlock the trial again once it is done.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000,000 Magnets.

guide.context: Polish Prestige and Refine Prestige reset Magnets, and Magnet upgrades spend them.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 18} to unlock Magnets.
Merge common minerals to collect Magnets.
Raise Magnet income with the More Magnets upgrade, the x2 Magnets on merge chance and the Moon Rune Magnet Amount upgrade.

achievements.summary: Buy every Refine Node from 1 to 50.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until every node from @mechanic{Refine Node 1} to @mechanic{Refine Node 50} is bought.

achievements.summary: Buy at least 1 level of Relic 35.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 3,400 to unlock @item{Relic 35} (Antique Wall Clock) in the Relics tab.
Buy one level of it with Gold.

achievements.description: Get a Zodiac with Rarity Immortal+200 or better
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Immortal+200 rarity or better by Uniting.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Luck with the Luck Bonus Mineral Upgrade, the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s and @item{Relic 4}.
Put Water Zodiacs on your Planets. Their Luck bonus works only after you buy Water Node 1 in the Elements tab, which Refine Node 55 unlocks.
Unite with new Zodiacs until one rolls Immortal+200 or better.

achievements.description: Reach Base Level 2+ for any of Special Minerals in SMP
achievements.summary: Reach Base Level 2 or higher for any Special Mineral in Special Minerals Progression (SMP).

guide.context: Merges done before Refine Node 46 add no progress.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 46} to unlock Special Minerals Progression.
Keep spawning Special Minerals and merge those of one type.
Stop when that type shows Base Level 2 in SMP.
steps.note: This takes 100 merges of that type, like a Level 7, a Level 6 and two Level 3 minerals. Expect about 800 spawns and roughly 40,000 Runes of each type.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 55 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until you have bought @mechanic{Refine Node 55}.
steps.note: This unlocks the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.

achievements.summary: Get at least 1 Fire.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Fire in the Elements subtab until you have 1.

achievements.summary: Get at least 100 Fire.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Fire in the Elements subtab until you have 100.

achievements.summary: Get at least 2 Earth.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Earth in the Elements subtab until you have 2.

achievements.summary: Get at least 400 Earth.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Earth in the Elements subtab until you have 400.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.08e308 or more Polish Points (PP).

guide.context: Spending PP on weapons lowers the PP you hold.

steps.text: Do Polish Prestige with a high mineral level to earn PP.
Repeat Polish Prestige, reaching higher mineral levels each time, until you hold 1.08e308 PP.

achievements.summary: Get at least 3 Wind.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Wind in the Elements subtab until you have 3.

achievements.summary: Get at least 1,000 Wind.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
