Generate Wind in the Elements subtab until you have 1,000.

achievements.summary: Get at least 5 Water.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Water in the Elements subtab until you have 5.

achievements.summary: Get at least 10,000 Water.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 55} to unlock the Elements subtab in the Unity tab.
Generate Water in the Elements subtab until you have 10,000.

achievements.displayName: Rarity Plus Goes Way Too Fast
achievements.description: Get a Zodiac with Immortal+300+ Rarity
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac of Immortal+300 rarity or higher by Uniting.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac Luck with the Luck Bonus Mineral Upgrade, the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s and @item{Relic 4}.
Put Water Zodiacs on your Planets. Their Luck bonus works only after you buy Water Node 1 in the Elements tab, which Refine Node 55 unlocks.
Unite with new Zodiacs until one rolls Immortal+300 or better.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 36.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 3,700 to unlock @item{Relic 36} (Wild Cucumber) in the Relics tab.
Buy one level of it with Gold.

achievements.displayName: I'm Tired Of Waiting For Attack Level
achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 56 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree until you have bought @mechanic{Refine Node 56}.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000,000 of each element: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: Generate each element in turn in the Elements subtab, since only one generates at a time.
Keep going until Fire, Earth, Wind and Water are each at 1,000,000 or more.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice Palate Expander (Relic 14).

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 360 to unlock @item{Relic 14} (Palate Expander), then buy it with Gold until it is level 301.
Sacrifice @item{Relic 14} in the Relics tab.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 37.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 3,800 to unlock @item{Relic 37} (The Venom-Tipped Charmer) in the Relics tab.
Buy one level of it with Gold.

achievements.summary: Reach 2.22e22 Refine Points (RfP).

steps.text: Do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} with a high mineral level to earn RfP.
Repeat Refine Prestige, reaching higher mineral levels each time, until you have 2.22e22 RfP.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e9 of each of the four elements: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: Generate each element in turn in the Elements subtab, since only one generates at a time.
Keep going until Fire, Earth, Wind and Water are each at 1e9 or more.

achievements.summary: Buy 2 or more levels of Refine Node 60 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Reach a Level 70 mineral, then do a @mechanic{Refine Prestige} to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP in the Refine Tree to buy two levels of @mechanic{Refine Node 60}.

achievements.summary: Spawn a mineral at level 228.

steps.text: Buy levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP until your spawn level can reach 228.
Set the spawn level to 228 and spawn a mineral.

achievements.displayName: With a new node... it's not hard
achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 256.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 5 to unlock Merge Level.
Merge matching common minerals to earn Merge Experience until Merge Level is 256.
steps.note: Polish and Refine reset Merge Level, so finish it within one run.

achievements.summary: Merge three Zodiacs of Immortal+1,000 rarity.

steps.text: Unlock Merging in the Planet Shop for 50 astrodust.
Get three Immortal+1,000 Zodiacs of the same element through Unity.
steps.note: This needs very high Luck, about 5e32.

steps.text: Put the three Zodiacs into Merging.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 4,000.

steps.text: In the Attacks tab, level up and ascend the Attack Circles so you keep defeating enemies until you reach Attack Level 4,000.
steps.note: Uniting resets Attack Level to 0.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+1 rarity through Unity.

steps.text: Merge three Immortal+1,000 Zodiacs in Merging to open Ethereal rarity.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Ethereal+1.
steps.note: Higher Luck gives better rarity.

achievements.summary: Have a mineral at level 250 or higher.

steps.text: Drag identical minerals onto each other to merge them until one is level 250 or higher.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 300.

steps.text: Keep merging common minerals until Merge Level is 300.
steps.note: Polish and Refine reset Merge Level, so finish it within one run.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 62 on the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Do a Refine Prestige (level 70 mineral needed) to earn Refine Points (RfP).
Spend RfP on Refine Node 62 in the Refine Tree.

achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+2 rarity through Unity.

steps.text: Merge three Immortal+1,000 Zodiacs in Merging to open Ethereal rarity.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Ethereal+2.
steps.note: Raise Luck for better rarity rolls.

achievements.summary: Buy Fire Node 6 in the Elements tab.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 55 to unlock Elements.
Generate Fire until you can pay 1e25, then buy Fire Node 6.

achievements.description: Reach Lv.3 of SMP for any special mineral
achievements.summary: Reach Base Level 3 in Special Minerals Progression for any one Special Mineral.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 46 to unlock Special Minerals Progression.
steps.note: Do not merge Special Minerals before buying it; those merges give no progress.

steps.text: Merge Special Minerals of one type to raise that type's Base Level to 3.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 66 on the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Earn Refine Points (RfP) with Refine Prestige.
Spend RfP on Refine Node 66 in the Refine Tree.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 39, the Windmill Pendant.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 5,000 to unlock Relic 39.
Buy Relic 39 in the Relics tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Reach a Global Element Mult of x1.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 55 to unlock the Elements tab.
Raise the global multiplier shown at the bottom of the Elements tab from /1e10 up to x1.
steps.note: Buy Relic 37 and Earth Node 6; Water Node 10 boosts it too.

achievements.summary: Buy Wind Node 6 in the Elements tab.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 55 to unlock Elements.
Generate Wind until you can pay 1e40, then buy Wind Node 6.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e50 of each of the four elements.

steps.text: Generate each element in turn until Fire, Earth, Wind and Water are all at 1e50 or more.

achievements.summary: Have a Special Minerals spawned factor (SMS Factor) of 7,500 or more.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 41 to unlock Special Minerals and spawn them with Sun and Moon Runes.
Keep spawning Special Minerals until the SMS Factor reaches 7,500.
steps.note: Cost climbs very fast past 7,500, so stop there.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e100 Wind.

steps.text: Set Wind as your generating element and let it build up to 1e100.

achievements.description: Get Ethereal+25 zodiac or better (through Unity)
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+25 or higher rarity through Unity.

steps.text: Merge three Immortal+1,000 Zodiacs in Merging to open Ethereal rarity.
Raise your Luck with the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s, Water Element Node 1 and @item{Relic} 4.
Unite until one of the offered Zodiacs is Ethereal+25 or better.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 40, the Ancient Gun.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 5,200 to unlock Relic 40.
Buy Relic 40 in the Relics tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 69 on the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Earn Refine Points (RfP) with Refine Prestige.
Spend RfP on Refine Node 69 in the Refine Tree.

achievements.description: Spawn Black gem for the first time
achievements.summary: Spawn a Black Gem for the first time.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 70, which adds Black Gems and unlocks Tarot.
Spawn Special Minerals until a Black Gem appears.
steps.note: Each spawn has only a small chance, starting at 1%.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1 Tarot Draw.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 70 so Black Gems can spawn, then collect five level 1 Black Gems.
steps.note: Each gives 0.2 draws.

steps.text: Delete the Black Gems to receive the draw.

achievements.summary: Draw 2 Tarot cards.

steps.text: Delete Black Gems to earn Tarot Draws.
Spend two draws in the Tarot tab.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e100,000 Gold.

steps.text: Climb Attack Levels in the Attacks tab, then Unite to collect the Gold paid out for that run.
steps.note: Uniting resets Attack Level to 0.

steps.text: Repeat until your Gold reaches 1e100,000.
steps.note: Earth Node 3, Relic 9, the Ace of Pentacles card and Yellow Special Minerals all raise Gold gain.

achievements.summary: Draw 4 Tarot cards.

steps.text: Delete Black Gems for Tarot Draws, then spend four draws in the Tarot tab.
steps.note: You receive The Chariot card as a reward.

achievements.displayName: A weapon against the special mineral cost scaling
achievements.description: Use Chariot for the first time
achievements.summary: Use The Chariot arcan for the first time.

steps.text: Activate The Chariot in the Tarot tab.
steps.note: It lowers your Special Minerals spawned factor (SMS Factor) by 1,000 and then has a 12-hour cooldown.

achievements.displayName: Don't always destroy your black gems
achievements.description: Get Lv.2 for black gem SMP
achievements.summary: Reach level 2 in Special Minerals Progression for the Black Gem.

steps.text: Merge Black Gems instead of deleting them so Black Gem progression grows.
steps.note: Progression needs Refine Node 46.

steps.text: Keep merging Black Gems until their Base Level is 2, which takes about 100 merges.

achievements.summary: Get the Five of Cups Tarot card.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until the Cups suit reaches Five of Cups.
steps.note: Cups cards arrive in order, from the Ace upward.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e50 Refine Points (RfP).

steps.text: Do repeated Refine Prestiges to build up Refine Points (RfP) until you hold 1e50.
steps.note: Light Blue Special Minerals add to RfP gain.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 20 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until the card levels add up to 20.
steps.note: Duplicates add a level to the card you already own.

achievements.displayName: There is a difference to the prev. ach.
achievements.summary: Own 20 different Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing until you own 20 different cards.
steps.note: Duplicates only raise a card's level.

achievements.description: Have 0 SMS Factor and have Lv.5 Black Gem on the grid at the same time
achievements.summary: Have a Special Minerals spawned factor (SMS Factor) of 0 while a level 5 Black Gem sits on the Special Minerals grid.

steps.text: Merge Black Gems on the Special Minerals grid until one is level 5.
Use The Chariot, repeating after its cooldown, until the SMS Factor reaches 0.
steps.note: Each use lowers the factor by 1,000 and has a 12-hour cooldown.

achievements.summary: Get an arcan card other than The Chariot.

guide.context: Arcans cannot appear in draws until your Tarot cards total 20 levels.

steps.text: Keep drawing Tarot cards until an arcan card appears.

achievements.displayName: Waterfall on the edge of the Earth
achievements.summary: Reach 1e100 Water.

steps.text: Set Water as your generating element and let it build up to 1e100.

achievements.displayName: Never tell personal things on Discord
achievements.summary: Get the Seven of Swords Tarot card.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until the Swords suit reaches Seven of Swords.
steps.note: Swords cards arrive in order, from the Ace upward.

achievements.displayName: A card for each day in November
achievements.summary: Own 30 different Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing until you own 30 different cards.
steps.note: Duplicates only raise a card's level.

achievements.description: Have 5+ cards (levels) of a certain card
achievements.summary: Have a Tarot card at level 5 or higher.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until one card has five levels.
steps.note: Each duplicate adds a level.

achievements.description: Have 2+ cards (levels) of any arcan card
achievements.summary: Have any arcan card at level 2 or higher.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until you get the same arcan a second time.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 50 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards until the card levels add up to 50.

achievements.description: Buy Relic 42 for the first time
achievements.summary: Buy Relic 42, Very Very Black Gem, for the first time.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 6,000 to unlock Relic 42.
Buy Relic 42 in the Relics tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Own 6 different arcan cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing until you own six different arcans.
steps.note: Duplicates only raise a card's level.

achievements.description: Make 2 arcans be active at the same time
achievements.summary: Have 2 arcans active at the same time.

steps.text: Activate an arcan with a duration, such as The Hermit (3 minutes).
Before it ends, activate a second arcan that has a duration.
steps.note: Instant arcans end at once and cannot overlap.

achievements.description: Make 3 arcans be active at the same time
achievements.summary: Have 3 arcans active at the same time.

steps.text: Own three arcans that have a duration, for example The Hermit, The Empress and The Star.
Activate all three before the shortest one ends.

achievements.displayName: It's time to say goodbye to the past
achievements.description: Get Special Minerals Grid be completely occupied at 9x9 size
achievements.summary: Fill every cell of a 9x9 Special Minerals grid at the same time.

steps.text: Buy levels of Refine Node 44 until the Special Minerals grid is 9x9.
Spawn Special Minerals until all 81 cells are filled.
steps.note: Merging frees cells, so avoid it.

achievements.summary: Raise the Special Minerals spawned factor (SMS Factor) above 10,000.

steps.text: Keep spawning Special Minerals past 7,500 until the Special Minerals spawned factor (SMS Factor) is above 10,000.
steps.note: Costs rise extremely fast past 7,500. Do not use The Chariot, which lowers the factor.

achievements.summary: Reach 8.15e9 Ascensions on the regular color circles.

steps.text: Buy your first Animal and reach Animals Milestone 1 to unlock Slowdown.
Get every color above 10 laps per second, then press the Slowdown button in the lower-left corner of the Revolution page.
steps.note: Each Slowdown adds 1 Ascension to every color.

steps.text: Repeat Slowdown and keep ascending the circles until the count reaches 8.15e9.
steps.note: Slowdowns reset on Infinity.

achievements.summary: Own 10 different arcan cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing until you own ten different arcans.
steps.note: Duplicates only raise a card's level.

achievements.description: Have 10 different cards for each suit (Swords, Wands, Pentacles, Cups)
achievements.summary: Own 10 different cards in each of the four suits: Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.

steps.text: Delete @item{Black Gem}s in the Special Minerals grid to earn Tarot Draws.
Draw cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until every suit has its cards from Ace to Ten.
steps.note: A suit's cards come in order, so you cannot skip ahead.

achievements.description: Have 10+ cards (levels) of a certain card
achievements.summary: Have one Tarot card at level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until one single card reaches level 10.
steps.note: The Sun arcan adds a level to a random card you already own.

achievements.description: Have 1M+ swords, clubs, pentacles and cups resources
achievements.summary: Have 1,000,000 or more of each Tarot resource: Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.

steps.text: Draw the Ace of every suit in the @loc{Tarot} tab so all four resources start generating.
Draw higher cards of each suit to speed up that resource, then wait until each one reaches 1,000,000.
steps.note: This unlocks the Tarot Upgrades menu.

achievements.summary: Raise the Black Gem to level 3 or higher in Special Minerals Progression.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 46 to unlock Special Minerals Progression.
Merge @item{Black Gem}s of the same level in the Special Minerals grid to earn Black Gem progression EXP until its level reaches 3.
steps.note: Merge only after Node 46 is bought, since earlier merges earn no progress.

achievements.description: Buy First Upgrade for all suits in Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy Upgrade 1 for Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups in Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Upgrade 1 for each suit with that suit's own resource.
steps.note: Each costs 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Get an Ethereal+50 Zodiac through Unity
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+50 rarity through Unity.

guide.context: Ethereal Zodiacs only show up after you have merged three Immortal+1,000 Zodiacs of one element and rarity in the @loc{Planet Shop}.

steps.text: Raise your Luck with the Luck Bonus Mineral Upgrade, the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s, Water Element Node 1 and @item{Relic} 4 until it passes 1.92e33, where Ethereal Zodiacs begin to appear.
Unite until one of the Zodiacs offered has Ethereal+50 rarity, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 7,000 or higher.

steps.text: In the @loc{Attacks} tab, level up the Attack Circles and keep defeating enemies until the Attack Level reaches 7,000.
steps.note: Uniting resets Attack Level to 0.

achievements.summary: Have a negative number of Tarot Draws.

guide.context: You must first draw The Wheel of Fortune arcan in the @loc{Tarot} tab.

steps.text: Spend your Tarot Draws until only a few are left.
Use The Wheel of Fortune again each time its 30-minute cooldown ends until a loss drops your draws below zero.
steps.note: The Wheel adds or removes up to 10 draws, and you need a positive count to use it.

achievements.description: Win the Wheel Of Fortune for 3 times in a row
achievements.summary: Win The Wheel of Fortune three times in a row.

guide.context: Each use is a 50% gamble, so a streak of three wins takes about 14 uses on average. You need a positive Tarot Draw count to use it.

steps.text: Draw The Wheel of Fortune arcan in the @loc{Tarot} tab if you do not own it yet.
steps.note: Arcans only appear in draws after you own 20 total card levels.

steps.text: Use The Wheel of Fortune each time its 30-minute cooldown ends.
If you lose, start counting again, until you win three uses in a row.

achievements.summary: Have 64 different Tarot cards.

guide.context: The four common suits hold only 56 cards, so at least 8 of the 64 must be arcans.

steps.text: Draw cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until you own 64 different ones, counting arcans.

achievements.summary: Have all 22 arcans.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until all 22 arcans are in your collection.

achievements.displayName: Are you ready to unpack all these cards?
achievements.summary: Have a Black Gem at level 12 or higher.

steps.text: In the Special Minerals grid, merge two @item{Black Gem}s of the same level to make one a level higher, again and again, until you have a level 12 Black Gem.
steps.note: Refine Node 70 is needed to spawn Black Gems.

achievements.summary: Have all 78 different Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until every card of all four suits and all 22 arcans is in your collection.
steps.note: Cards of a suit come in order.

achievements.summary: Have a mineral at level 401.

steps.text: In the @loc{Minerals} tab, merge two identical minerals again and again until one reaches level 401.
steps.note: Buy levels of the Max Level mineral upgrade with VP to raise the level your minerals spawn at and save merges.

achievements.displayName: Will be there new rarities after plus x10?
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+100 or higher rarity through Unity.

steps.text: Raise your Luck with the Luck Bonus Mineral Upgrade, the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s, Water Element Node 1 and @item{Relic} 4; Ethereal+100 needs more Luck than Ethereal+50.
Unite until one of the Zodiacs offered has Ethereal+100 or better rarity, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Have 1,000 total Tarot card levels.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until your total card levels reach 1,000.
steps.note: @item{Relic} 41, 42 and 43 raise how many Tarot Draws and cards you get.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e700,000 Gold.

steps.text: Push your Attack Level higher before each Unite, because the Gold you get from Uniting grows with it.
Raise Gold gain with @item{Relic} 9, 17 and 21, @item{Yellow Gem}s and the Spear in Polish.

achievements.description: Buy Second Upgrade for all suits in Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy Upgrade 2 for Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups in Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Upgrade 2 for each suit with that suit's own resource.
steps.note: Each costs 1e9 and needs Upgrade 1.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 73 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Do Refine Prestiges in the @loc{Minerals} tab to earn Refine Points (RfP), then spend them in the Refine Tree until Refine Node 73 is bought.

achievements.summary: Have 5,000 total Tarot card levels.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until your total card levels reach 5,000.

achievements.description: Have 10,000+ tarot cards (levels) and 78 unique tarot cards
achievements.summary: Have 10,000 total Tarot card levels and all 78 different Tarot cards.

steps.text: Complete your collection of all 78 cards, then keep drawing until the total card levels reach 10,000.

achievements.displayName: Tarot currencies have their own purpose
achievements.description: Buy Third Upgrade for all suits in Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy Upgrade 3 for Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups in Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Upgrade 3 for each suit with that suit's own resource.
steps.note: Each costs 1e12 and needs Upgrade 2.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e1,000,000 Gold.

steps.text: Keep pushing your Attack Level before each Unite so the Gold gained grows.
steps.note: @item{Relic} 9, 17 and 21 raise Gold gain.

achievements.summary: Raise any Special Mineral to level 5 or higher in Special Minerals Progression.

steps.text: Merge Special Minerals of the same type to earn progression EXP until one type reaches level 5 in Special Minerals Progression.
steps.note: Merge only after Refine Node 46 is bought.

achievements.summary: Have a mineral at level 500 or higher.

steps.text: In the @loc{Minerals} tab, keep merging identical minerals until one reaches level 500.

achievements.description: Buy Element Node 7 for all elements
achievements.summary: Buy Node 7 in the Fire, Earth, Wind and Water element trees.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate each element in turn and buy its Node 7 with that element.
steps.note: Node 7 costs 1e500, except Water at 1e350.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e100,000 Polish Points (PP).

steps.text: Raise your highest mineral level, then do Polish Prestiges in the @loc{Minerals} tab to earn PP.
steps.note: @item{Dark Purple Gem}s raise PP gain.

achievements.description: Get a Zodiac with Ethereal+1000 rarity through Unity
achievements.summary: Pick a Zodiac of Ethereal+1000 rarity when you Unite.

steps.text: Raise your Luck with the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s, Water Element Node 1 and @item{Relic} 4 to at least 3.08e296, where Ethereal+1000 rarity begins.
Unite until one of the Zodiacs offered has Ethereal+1000 rarity, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 45.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 7,500 to unlock Relic 45.
Buy @item{Relic} 45 with Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab.

achievements.description: Have 1,000+ cards (levels) of each of 78 cards
achievements.summary: Have 1,000 levels of every one of the 78 Tarot cards.

steps.text: Complete your collection of 78 cards, then keep drawing until every single card has 1,000 levels.

achievements.displayName: Max Level for the special minerals
achievements.summary: Get one Special Mineral to level 20.

steps.text: In the Special Minerals grid, merge two Special Minerals of the same type and level to raise it by one, again and again, until one reaches level 20.
steps.note: A higher spawn level from Special Minerals Progression means fewer merges.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e100 Refine Points (RfP).

steps.text: Raise your highest mineral level, then do Refine Prestiges in the @loc{Minerals} tab to earn RfP.
steps.note: @item{Light Blue Gem}s raise RfP gain.

achievements.displayName: This is how life was created
achievements.summary: Have 1e1,000 of each element: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate one element at a time and switch until all four reach 1e1,000.
steps.note: Wands, Pentacles, Swords and Cups cards boost Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

achievements.description: Get Lv.3 for all tarot suits upgrade-3
achievements.summary: Get Upgrade 3 to level 3 for Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups in Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: Buy Upgrade 4 for each suit until it reaches level 2.
steps.note: Upgrade 4 needs Upgrade 3 at level 1 first.

steps.text: Buy Upgrade 3 for each suit until it reaches level 3.
steps.note: Each Upgrade 4 level raises the max level of Upgrades 1 to 4 by one.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 80 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Keep doing Refine Prestiges in the @loc{Minerals} tab and spend the Refine Points (RfP) in the Refine Tree until Refine Node 80 is bought.

achievements.summary: Have 1,000,000 total Tarot card levels.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until your total card levels reach 1,000,000.
steps.note: @item{Relic} 41, 42 and 43 raise how many cards you get.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e6,666,666 Gold.

steps.text: Keep pushing your Attack Level before each Unite so the Gold gained grows.
steps.note: @item{Relic} 9, 17 and 21 raise Gold gain.

achievements.displayName: Can forget about element tree now
achievements.description: Buy last node in all elements trees
achievements.summary: Buy the last node in the Fire, Earth, Wind and Water element trees.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, buy Fire Node 11, Earth Node 10, Wind Node 12 and Water Node 11, each with its own element.

achievements.summary: Obtain an Amazing Zodiac.

steps.text: Get three Ethereal+1000 Zodiacs of the same element.
In the @loc{Planet Shop}, unlock Merging and merge those three Zodiacs.
steps.note: Merging costs 50 astrodust to unlock.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 46.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 10,000 to unlock Relic 46.
Buy @item{Relic} 46 with Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 85 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points (RfP) in the Refine Tree until Refine Node 85 is bought.
steps.note: Node 85 adds the Sacrifice tab to Minerals.

achievements.description: Obtain an Amazing+1+ zodiac through Unity
achievements.summary: Get a Zodiac with Amazing+1 or higher rarity through Unity.

steps.text: Raise your Luck with the Planet Shop Luck donut, @item{Pink Gem}s, Water Element Node 1 and @item{Relic} 4 past 3.3e296, where Amazing rarity begins.
Unite until one of the Zodiacs offered has Amazing+1 or higher rarity, then pick it.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice one type of Special Mineral.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 85 to unlock sacrificing.
Destroy 100 Level 20 minerals of one Special Mineral type, by deleting them or with The Tower arcan or a macro.
Open the Sacrifice tab in @loc{Minerals} and sacrifice that type.
steps.note: That type cannot be spawned again until every type is sacrificed.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice five types of Special Mineral.

steps.text: Repeat the sacrifice for four more types, each needing 100 destroyed Level 20 minerals of that type.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice all 10 types of Special Mineral.

steps.text: Keep repeating the sacrifice until all 10 types, including the Black Gem, have been sacrificed.
steps.note: Each type needs 100 destroyed Level 20 minerals.

achievements.description: Upgrade all Tarot Upgrade 4 bonuses to Level 4+
achievements.summary: Get Upgrade 4 to level 4 or higher for Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups in Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: Buy Upgrade 4 again and again for each suit until its level is 4.
steps.note: Upgrade 4 needs Upgrade 3 at level 1 first, and it raises its own max level, so you can keep buying it.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e12 total Tarot card levels.

steps.text: Keep drawing cards in the @loc{Tarot} tab until your total card levels reach 1e12.
steps.note: @item{Relic} 41, 42 and 43 raise how many cards you get.

achievements.description: Unlock Upgrade 5 for Swords Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Unlock Upgrade 5 in the Swords list of Tarot Upgrades.

steps.text: In the Swords list, buy Upgrades 1, 2 and 3 in order with Swords resource.
steps.note: They cost 1,000,000, 1e9 and 1e12.

steps.text: Buy Swords Upgrade 4 until it reaches level 4.
steps.note: Level 4 of Upgrade 4 unlocks Upgrade 5.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 86 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Refine Tree} and buy @mechanic{Refine Node 86} with Refine Points.

achievements.summary: Have a combined total of at least 1e14 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Destroy Black Gems to earn Tarot draws.
Spend draws on cards until the levels of all your cards add up to 1e14.
steps.note: Each extra copy of a card adds a level, and @item{The Sun} adds levels to a random card you own.

achievements.description: Unlock Upgrade 5 for Wands Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Unlock Upgrade 5 in the Wands list of Tarot Upgrades.

guide.context: The Tarot Upgrades menu appears once Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups each reach 1,000,000.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Wands Upgrades 1, 2 and 3 first, one level each.
steps.note: Each one needs the one before it at level 1.

steps.text: Spend Wands on Wands Upgrade 4 until it is level 4.
steps.note: Upgrade 4 raises its own maximum level by 1 per level.

steps.text: Wands Upgrade 5 then unlocks.

achievements.displayName: No More Stupid AI Polls in Recommendations
achievements.summary: Buy Relic 48 in the Relics tab.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 14,000 to unlock @item{Relic 48} (Blue Sponge).
Buy it with Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 87 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Refine Tree} and buy @mechanic{Refine Node 87} with Refine Points.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e3,250 Fire.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, set Fire as the element you generate.
Let it run and level Wands cards to raise Fire gain until Fire reaches 1e3,250.
steps.note: Only one element generates at a time.

achievements.description: Win The Wheel Of Fortune 64 times in a row
achievements.summary: Win the Wheel of Fortune Tarot card 64 times in a row.

steps.text: Use @item{Wheel of Fortune} each time its cooldown ends.
steps.note: It wins about half the time, and a loss ends the streak. You need at least one Tarot draw to use it.

achievements.description: Reach SMP Lv.20 for all Special Minerals
achievements.summary: Raise every Special Mineral to level 20 in Special Minerals Progression (SMP).

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 46 (200,000,000 Refine Points) to unlock SMP, and only merge Special Minerals after that.
steps.note: Merges made before SMP is unlocked give no progress.

steps.text: In the Special Minerals grid, merge Special Minerals of one type to fill that type's SMP experience bar.
Repeat for every type until all of them are at SMP level 20.
steps.note: @item{Relic 45} raises the SMP experience from each merge.

achievements.displayName: When It's Golden, It's the Best!
achievements.description: Sacrifice a Yellow Special Gem to Lv. 28+
achievements.summary: Raise a sacrificed Yellow Special Gem to level 28 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 85 to unlock the Sacrifice tab inside the Minerals tab.
Sacrifice every Special Mineral type: delete 100 minerals of level 20 for each type.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust}.
In the Sacrifice tab, spend 1,000,000 Sacrifice Dust to take the Yellow Gem from level 27 to 28.

achievements.summary: Complete one Tarot Challenge.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 89 to unlock the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab.
Pick a challenge that is available and reach its goal inside it.
steps.note: For example, the Ace of Wands challenge ends at 1e20 Water.

achievements.summary: Have at least e1e9 Gold, which is 10 raised to the power of 1,000,000,000.

steps.text: In the @loc{Attacks} tab, defeat enemies to raise your Attack Level and the Gold you would receive.
Unite to be paid that Gold, and repeat until you hold e1e9.
steps.note: The Yellow Gem and the Ace of Pentacles card raise Gold gain.

achievements.summary: Complete 4 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 4 are complete.
steps.note: Each suit unlocks its next card's challenge only after the previous one is done.

achievements.description: Have 2+ sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.28+
achievements.summary: Have at least 2 sacrificed Special Minerals at level 28 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise 2 sacrificed minerals to level 28.
steps.note: Level 28 costs 1,000,000 Sacrifice Dust per mineral.

achievements.description: Have 5+ sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.28+
achievements.summary: Have at least 5 sacrificed Special Minerals at level 28 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise 5 sacrificed minerals to level 28.
steps.note: Level 28 costs 1,000,000 Sacrifice Dust per mineral.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.28+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 28 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 28.
steps.note: Level 28 costs 1,000,000 Sacrifice Dust per mineral.

achievements.summary: Reach Merge Level 10,000 or higher.

steps.text: Merge identical common minerals to earn Merge Experience until your Merge Level is 10,000.
steps.note: Polish and Refine Prestige reset Merge Level.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 90 in the Refine Tree.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Refine Tree} and buy @mechanic{Refine Node 90} with Refine Points.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 50 in the Relics tab.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 16,000 to unlock @item{Relic 50} (Troll Face).
Buy it with Gold in the @loc{Relics} tab.

achievements.summary: Have a combined total of at least 1e15 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Destroy Black Gems to earn Tarot draws.
Spend draws on cards until the levels of all your cards add up to 1e15.
steps.note: Each extra copy of a card adds a level, and @item{The Sun} adds levels to a random card you own.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.29+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 29 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 29.
steps.note: Level 29 costs 4,000,000 Sacrifice Dust.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e256 Refine Points.

steps.text: Do Refine Prestiges to earn Refine Points until you hold 1e256.
steps.note: The Light Blue Gem raises Refine Points gained.

achievements.summary: Reach a Luck of at least 1e1,800.

steps.text: Raise Luck with the Pink Gem and Pentacles Tarot Upgrade 5 until it reaches 1e1,800.
steps.note: The Star arcan also multiplies Luck for a short time.

achievements.summary: Complete 9 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 9 are complete.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.30+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 30 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 30.
steps.note: Level 30 costs 81,000,000 Sacrifice Dust.

achievements.summary: Reach a Score of at least e1e25, which is 10 raised to the power of 1e25.

steps.text: Keep growing Score with Circle levels, multipliers and your prestige layers until it passes e1e25.

achievements.displayName: Was It Even Possible Before Special Mineral Sacrifice?
achievements.description: Reach Upgrade 4 Lv.5+ for all Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Raise Upgrade 4 to level 5 or higher in every Tarot Upgrades list.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Upgrade 4 in the Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups lists until each is level 5 or higher.
steps.note: Upgrade 4 raises its own maximum level by 1 per level.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e10,000 of each element: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate each element in turn.
Raise element factors and the Global Element multiplier, for example with Wands cards, until all four reach 1e10,000.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.32+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 32 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 32.
steps.note: Level 32 costs 3.91e11 Sacrifice Dust.

achievements.summary: Have a combined total of at least 1e17 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Destroy Black Gems to earn Tarot draws.
Spend draws on cards until the levels of all your cards add up to 1e17.
steps.note: Each extra copy of a card adds a level, and @item{The Sun} adds levels to a random card you own.

achievements.summary: Complete The Magician Tarot Challenge, which ends when all four elements reach 1e5,000.

steps.text: Complete The Fool challenge first, because Arcana challenges unlock in order.
Start The Magician challenge, which resets your Elements.
Select an element to generate, then use the @item{The Magician} card to produce elements until each one reaches 1e5,000.
steps.note: The card only works while an element is generating. Each use lowers the Global Element multiplier, and the card has a 4-hour cooldown.

achievements.summary: Complete 18 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 18 are complete.

achievements.summary: Have at least e1e9 Value Points, which is 10 raised to the power of 1,000,000,000.

steps.text: Merge minerals and buy VP upgrades to raise Value Points until you hold e1e9.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 20 are complete.

achievements.description: Reach the max level of Refine Node 90
achievements.summary: Raise Refine Node 90 to its maximum level.

steps.text: Keep buying levels of @mechanic{Refine Node 90} in the Refine Tree until no more levels can be bought.

achievements.summary: Buy Upgrade 6 in the Wands list of Tarot Upgrades.

guide.context: Wands Upgrade 5 first needs Wands Upgrade 4 at level 4 or higher.

steps.text: In @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, buy Wands Upgrade 5 up to level 2.
steps.note: Level 1 costs 1e210 Wands and level 2 costs more.

steps.text: Buy Wands Upgrade 6.
steps.note: Level 1 costs 1e320 Wands.

achievements.summary: Complete The Hierophant Tarot Challenge, which ends at Max Mineral Level 1,380.

steps.text: Complete the earlier Arcana challenges in order: The Fool, The Magician, The High Priestess, The Empress and The Emperor.
Start The Hierophant challenge. It performs a Refine Prestige and only level 1 minerals can spawn.
Merge minerals and use the @item{The Hierophant} card, whose cooldown is 50 times shorter here, until a mineral reaches level 1,380.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e30,000 of each element: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate each element in turn.
Raise element factors and the Global Element multiplier, for example with Wands cards, until all four reach 1e30,000.

achievements.summary: Have a combined total of at least 1e20 levels across all your Tarot cards.

steps.text: Destroy Black Gems to earn Tarot draws.
Spend draws on cards until the levels of all your cards add up to 1e20.
steps.note: Each extra copy of a card adds a level, and @item{The Sun} adds levels to a random card you own.

achievements.summary: Raise the Polish Sword to level 1,000 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Polish Prestiges to earn Polish Points (PP).
steps.note: You need to own a level 30 mineral before the first Polish Prestige.

steps.text: Spend PP on the Sword in the @loc{Polish} tab until it is level 1,000.

achievements.summary: Have at least e2e9 Value Points, which is 10 raised to the power of 2,000,000,000.

steps.text: Merge minerals and buy VP upgrades to raise Value Points until you hold e2e9.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.40+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 40 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 40.
steps.note: Each level costs far more Sacrifice Dust than the one before.

achievements.description: Complete Three Of Swords Tarot Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete the Three of Swords Tarot Challenge, which ends at Attack Level 200.

steps.text: Complete the Ace of Swords challenge (Attack Level 1500) and the Two of Swords challenge (Attack Level 400) first.
Start Three of Swords and reach Attack Level 200.
steps.note: Game Speed, Attack and Damage multipliers are cut hard inside it.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.41+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 41 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type first, because @mechanic{Sacrifice Dust} only starts after all types are sacrificed.
Spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust, then spend it in the Sacrifice tab to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 41.
steps.note: Each level costs far more Sacrifice Dust than the one before.

achievements.description: Complete Five Of Swords Tarot Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete the Five of Swords Tarot Challenge, which ends at Attack Level 2,026.

steps.text: Complete Ace, Two, Three and Four of Swords first, in that order (Attack Levels 1,500, 400, 200 and 2,000).
Start Five of Swords and reach Attack Level 2,026.
steps.note: Attack Levels reset when it starts.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 30 are complete.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e100,000 of each element: Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate each element in turn.
Raise element factors and the Global Element multiplier, for example with Wands cards, until all four reach 1e100,000.

achievements.summary: Obtain a Prime-rarity Zodiac.

steps.text: Get three Amazing+1000 zodiacs of the same element.
In the @loc{Planet Shop}, buy Merging for 50 astrodust, then merge the three zodiacs.

achievements.summary: Complete 35 Tarot Challenges.

steps.text: Finish challenges in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab until 35 are complete.

achievements.summary: Own a mineral at level 1,800 or higher.

steps.text: Merge two minerals of the same level to make a higher one, and raise the @mechanic{Max Level} mineral upgrade until you hold a level 1,800 mineral.

achievements.description: Complete Eight Of Cups Tarot Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete the Eight of Cups Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: Tarot Challenges unlock with @mechanic{Refine Node 89}, and each suit's challenges must be finished in card order, so complete every earlier card's challenge first. For Cups, finish Ace of Cups through Seven of Cups first.

steps.text: Enter the @item{Eight of Cups} challenge in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab.
Unite with a Zodiac of Legendary rarity or better while inside the challenge.

achievements.description: Have more than 1,6e10 free Ascensions from slowdowns
achievements.summary: Have more than 16 billion free Ascensions from Slowdowns.

guide.context: A Slowdown divides lap speed by 10 and adds 1 Ascension to every color. Slowdowns reset to 0 on Infinity, Eternity and Unity.

steps.text: Press Slowdown on the @loc{Revolution} page whenever every color has more than 10 laps per second.
Turn on @mechanic{Auto Slowdown} and set it to 10 laps per second once it unlocks.
Unite with Sagittarius Zodiacs, which add to Slowdown Power and so give more Ascensions per Slowdown.

achievements.description: Complete Seven Of Swords Tarot Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete the Seven of Swords Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: Tarot Challenges unlock with @mechanic{Refine Node 89}, and each suit's challenges must be finished in card order, so complete every earlier card's challenge first. For Swords, finish Ace of Swords through Six of Swords first.

steps.text: Enter the @item{Seven of Swords} challenge in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab.
Reach Attack Level 2,525 while inside the challenge.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e500 of each of the four Tarot resources: Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.

steps.text: Raise all four Tarot resources to 1e500. The Ace card of each suit makes that suit's resource, and the higher cards of the suit speed it up.

achievements.description: Upgrade Refine Node 1 to max level
achievements.summary: Upgrade Refine Node 1 to its maximum level.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points on @mechanic{Refine Node 1} in the Refine Tree until it cannot be upgraded any further.

achievements.description: Obtain your first part for all Artifacts
achievements.summary: Own the first part of all four Artifacts.

guide.context: Refine Node 99 costs 1e1,000 Refine Points.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 99} to open the @loc{Artifacts} tab.
Check that each of the four Artifacts shows its first part. Part 1 needs no Golden Resources.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 1e27 (1 Octillion) levels across all Tarot cards.

steps.text: Destroy Black Gems to earn Tarot draws, and use the draws on cards. The Sun arcan adds levels to a random owned card. Keep going until the total reaches 1e27.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.50+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 50 or higher.

guide.context: Sacrifice needs @mechanic{Refine Node 85}. Sacrifice Dust only starts once every Special Mineral type has been sacrificed.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type: delete 100 minerals of that type at level 20.
Spawn Special Minerals to collect Sacrifice Dust, then spend it to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 50.

achievements.description: Obtain your second part for all artifacts
achievements.summary: Own the second part of all four Artifacts.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab until you hold at least 8 of each Golden Resource: Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.
Check that each of the four Artifacts shows its second part.

achievements.description: Reach Upgrade 4 Lv.8+ for all Tarot Upgrades
achievements.summary: Raise Upgrade 4 to level 8 or higher in all four Tarot suits.

steps.text: Open @loc{Tarot Upgrades}, which appears when every Tarot resource has reached one million.
In each suit, buy Upgrades 1 to 3, then buy Upgrade 4 again and again until it reaches level 8. Upgrade 4 raises its own maximum level.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1.11e1,111 Refine Points.

steps.text: Perform Refine Prestige again and again, and raise Refine Point gain with the Light Blue Gem and the Death arcan, until you hold 1.11e1,111 Refine Points.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 1e30 (1 Nonillion) levels across all Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep destroying Black Gems for Tarot draws and use the Sun arcan to add card levels, until the total reaches 1e30.

achievements.summary: Complete 40 Tarot Challenges.

guide.context: Tarot Challenges unlock with @mechanic{Refine Node 89}, and each suit's challenges must be finished in card order, so complete every earlier card's challenge first.

steps.text: Complete Tarot Challenges across the suits until 40 are done.

achievements.summary: Reach level 7 or higher on any Artifact.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab to turn Tarot resources into Golden Resources, then upgrade Artifact parts with them. Upgrading does not use them up.

achievements.description: Obtain a Prime+1 or better Zodiac through Unity
achievements.summary: Obtain a Zodiac of Prime+1 rarity or better through Unity.

steps.text: Merge three Amazing+1000 Zodiacs to unlock Prime Zodiacs.
Raise your Luck past 1.57e1472, where the Prime rarity range starts. Prime+1 or better needs at least that much.
Unite and pick a Zodiac of Prime+1 rarity or better.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e42 Sun Runes and 1e42 Moon Runes at the same time.

steps.text: Raise both rune types with the @loc{Runes} upgrades, such as Generation Rate and Generation Amount, until each reaches 1e42.

achievements.description: Obtain a Lv.1,600+ Zodiac through Unity
achievements.summary: Obtain a Zodiac of level 1,600 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Raise your Zodiac Exp factors so the Zodiac level climbs, then Unite and pick a Zodiac of level 1,600 or higher.

achievements.summary: Own a mineral at level 2,026 or higher.

steps.text: Merge same-level minerals and keep raising the @mechanic{Max Level} mineral upgrade until you hold a level 2,026 mineral.

achievements.summary: Complete The Hermit Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: The Hermit is an arcana challenge. Arcana challenges unlock in order, so finish The Fool through Justice first. Tarot Challenges unlock with @mechanic{Refine Node 89}.

steps.text: Enter the @item{The Hermit} challenge in the @loc{Tarot Challenges} tab.
Use The Hermit arcan as often as you can, because each use weakens the challenge penalty.
Reach 1e1,000 or more of every Tarot resource.

achievements.summary: Reach 8.15 billion Ascension in Attack Revolutions.

steps.text: Level and ascend your Attack Circles again and again to raise their Ascension Stage toward 8.15 billion.

achievements.description: Reach a total of 75+ Artifact levels
achievements.summary: Reach a combined total of 75 Artifact levels.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab to gain Golden Resources, then upgrade Artifact parts with them until the combined Artifact level reaches 75.

achievements.description: Obtain a Zodiac with quality 1e3,000+ through Unity
achievements.summary: Obtain a Zodiac with quality 1e3,000 or higher through Unity.

steps.text: Raise Zodiac quality with the Ace of Cups card, Pink Gems and The Moon arcan, then Unite and pick a Zodiac with quality 1e3,000 or more.

achievements.summary: Unite with a Zodiac of level 2,000 or higher.

steps.text: Raise your Zodiac Exp factors until a Zodiac reaches level 2,000, then Unite and pick it.

achievements.displayName: Last Upgrade… for Most of Them
achievements.description: Purchase Upgrade 9 for every Tarot suit
achievements.summary: Buy Upgrade 9 in all four Tarot suits.

steps.text: In each suit, buy Upgrades 1 to 8 in order. Upgrade 5 needs Upgrade 4 at level 4, and Upgrades 6, 7 and 8 each need the one before at level 2.
Gather 1e2,000 of each Tarot resource and buy Upgrade 9 in every suit, once Upgrade 8 is at level 1.

achievements.description: Unite with a Prime+5 or better Zodiac
achievements.summary: Unite with a Zodiac of Prime+5 rarity or better.

steps.text: Merge three Amazing+1000 Zodiacs to unlock Prime Zodiacs.
Raise your Luck high enough to roll Prime+5 or better. Prime+x requirements grow very fast, and the Prime range starts at 1.57e1472.
Unite and pick a Zodiac of Prime+5 rarity or better.

achievements.description: Have 1,000+ of each Golden Resource type
achievements.summary: Have at least 1,000 of each Golden Resource: Golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.

guide.context: Flushing gives Golden Resources at once, but cuts that Tarot resource's generation (^0.001) until the penalty fades over 10 hours.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab for each suit.
Flush again once your resources have recovered, until you hold 1,000 of each Golden Resource.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Magic Skull part Ramus to level 10 or higher.

steps.text: Open the Magic Skull in the @loc{Artifacts} tab.
Press Flush for Wands to gain Golden Wands, then upgrade Ramus, part 1, to level 10. Upgrading does not use them up.

achievements.summary: Have at least e1e13 Gold, which is 10 raised to the power of 10 trillion.

steps.text: Unite at high Attack Levels to earn Gold, and raise Gold gain until it reaches e1e13.

achievements.displayName: How Did It Scale So Much?
achievements.summary: Have at least 1e2,000 Refine Points.

steps.text: Perform Refine Prestige again and again, and raise Refine Point gain, until you hold 1e2,000 Refine Points.

achievements.summary: Reach level 40 or higher on all four Artifacts.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab to gain Golden Resources, then upgrade the parts of each Artifact until all four reach level 40.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.60+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 60 or higher.

guide.context: Sacrifice needs @mechanic{Refine Node 85}. Sacrifice Dust only starts once every Special Mineral type has been sacrificed.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type: delete 100 minerals of that type at level 20.
Spawn Special Minerals to collect Sacrifice Dust, then spend it to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 60.

achievements.description: Obtain the 7th part of your Magic Skull
achievements.summary: Obtain the 7th part of the Magic Skull Artifact.

steps.text: Press Flush for Wands in the @loc{Artifacts} tab until you hold 18,000 Golden Wands, which unlocks part 7, Zygomatics.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 1e50 levels across all Tarot cards.

steps.text: Keep destroying Black Gems for Tarot draws and use the Sun arcan to add card levels, until the total reaches 1e50.

achievements.displayName: A Man Should Be Slightly More Handsome Than a Monkey
achievements.summary: Buy Relic 60.

steps.text: Reach Attack Level 32,500 to unlock Relic 60.
Buy Relic 60 in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold.

achievements.displayName: And This Is How To Reach It
achievements.summary: Upgrade the Magic Skull part Maxilla to level 8 or higher.

steps.text: Press Flush for Wands in the @loc{Artifacts} tab until you hold 100 Golden Wands, which unlocks part 4, Maxilla, in the Magic Skull.
Keep flushing Wands and upgrade Maxilla to level 8. Upgrading does not use up the Golden Wands.

achievements.summary: Complete 52 Tarot Challenges.

guide.context: Tarot Challenges unlock with @mechanic{Refine Node 89}, and each suit's challenges must be finished in card order, so complete every earlier card's challenge first.

steps.text: Complete Tarot Challenges across the suits until 52 are done.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.63+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 63 or higher.

guide.context: Sacrifice needs @mechanic{Refine Node 85}. Sacrifice Dust only starts once every Special Mineral type has been sacrificed.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type: delete 100 minerals of that type at level 20.
Spawn Special Minerals to collect Sacrifice Dust, then spend it to raise each sacrificed mineral to level 63.

achievements.description: Get all parts for all artifacts
achievements.summary: Own every part of all four Artifacts.

steps.text: Press Flush in the @loc{Artifacts} tab for every suit until you hold enough Golden Resources for every part. The last parts need 1,000,000 Golden Swords, 1,800,000 Golden Wands, 1,250,000 Golden Pentacles and 1,500,000 Golden Cups.

achievements.summary: Reach Attack Level 33,333.

steps.text: Raise Attack damage with Attack Circle multipliers and Relics until you reach Attack Level 33,333 in one Unity run.

achievements.summary: Unlock the Plague tab.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 103} in the Refine Tree to open the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Complete Plague stage 1-2, named Shack.

steps.text: Press INITIATE INFECTION at the bottom of the @loc{Plague} tab.
Infect all 5 people in Tent (1-1), then all 7 in Shack (1-2).

achievements.summary: Own 10 or more Plague Generators.

steps.text: Clear stages 1-1 to 1-4 (Tent, Shack, Cabin, Trailer). They give 1, 2, 4 and 5 Plague Generators.

achievements.summary: Infect a total population of 100 or more.

steps.text: Keep clearing stages. The Total Infected statistic adds up everyone you infect until it reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Abandon, win or lose an infection 50 or more times in total.

steps.text: Start an infection with INITIATE INFECTION, then end it by abandoning it, winning it or losing it.
Do this 50 times, using an early stage with a small population.

achievements.summary: Give your Virus a name.

steps.text: Type a name for your virus at the top left of the @loc{Plague} tab, next to the animated viruses.

achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum of level 5 or higher.

guide.context: Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) crafting opens with @mechanic{Refine Node 104}. Each craft level needs an ER of the previous level first.

steps.text: Flush part of your Plague Points in the Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) section to build Endoplasmic Reticulum Points (ERP) and receive an ER.
Raise the craft level one step at a time, crafting an ER at each level up to level 5.

achievements.summary: Hold 100 or more Virus Essence.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 104}, then flush Plague Points in the Endoplasmic Reticulum section of the @loc{Plague} tab to craft Endoplasmic Reticulums.
Dissolve unwanted Endoplasmic Reticulums for Virus Essence. Decay type ones give the most.

achievements.summary: Buy any Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) upgrade.

steps.text: Craft an @mechanic{Endoplasmic Reticulum} in the @loc{Plague} tab, then dissolve it to gain Virus Essence.
Spend the Virus Points that Virus Essence produces on any ER upgrade.

achievements.summary: Complete all twelve Houses Plague stages, 1-1 through 1-12.

steps.text: Infect every Houses stage in order, ending with stage 1-12, Compound (400 people).

achievements.description: Craft ER with B rarity or better
achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) of B rarity (Rare) or better.

steps.text: Keep crafting ERs in the @loc{Plague} tab until one comes out at B rarity or higher.
Buy Crafting Mastery in the ER upgrades to raise the chance of better rarity.

achievements.description: Reach 5,000,000+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have 5,000,000 or more of each golden Tarot resource (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 99} to unlock Artifacts, then press Flush to convert each Tarot resource into its golden form.
Keep flushing every suit until each golden resource reaches 5,000,000.

achievements.summary: Have a total of 6.70e67 or more Tarot card levels.

steps.text: Delete Black Gems, a rare Special Mineral, to earn Tarot draws. Five Level 1 Black Gems are needed for the first full draw.
Spend the draws on Tarot cards.

achievements.summary: Complete all twelve Towns Plague stages, 2-1 through 2-12.

steps.text: Infect every Towns stage in order, ending with stage 2-12, Smokehaven (24,000 people).

achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) of level 20 or higher.

steps.text: Raise the craft level in the @loc{Plague} tab one level at a time, crafting an ER at each level, until you craft one at level 20 or higher.

achievements.summary: Reach a spread speed of 70 or more per second in an Islands-level or later Plague stage.

steps.text: Reach the Islands level of @loc{Plague}, then raise spread speed with the Base Spread Power ER upgrade and with ERs that have high Spread Power, such as Outbreak or Strain types.

achievements.summary: Complete all twelve Islands Plague stages, 3-1 through 3-12.

guide.context: From the Islands level on, the healthy people work on a cure that lowers spread speed once it finishes, so finish each stage quickly.

steps.text: Infect every Islands stage in order, ending with stage 3-12, Grand Mere (125,000 people).

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 61.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 34,500, then buy @item{Relic 61} in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Have a Crystal Mirror artifact at level 90 or higher.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with @mechanic{Refine Node 99}, then upgrade the Crystal Mirror with golden Swords until it reaches level 90.

achievements.summary: Complete Iceland, Plague stage 4-3.

steps.text: Infect all 390,000 people of stage 4-3, Iceland, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Complete Georgia, Plague stage 4-4.

steps.text: Infect all 3,800,000 people of stage 4-4, Georgia, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Lose a Plague stage.

steps.text: Keep playing @loc{Plague} stages from the Islands level on, where the healthy population works on a cure, until a stage is lost.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 62.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 35,000, then buy @item{Relic 62} in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Reach 1 or more Plague Points (PlP) per second for each Plague Generator (PlG).

steps.text: Raise the PlP per PlG stat in the @loc{Plague} tab to 1 or more. Buy @item{Relic 61}, and infect people in the Universe stage (Plague level 6) to raise the Max Infected in Universe statistic.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e10 or more Virus Points (ViP).

steps.text: Dissolve ERs to gather Virus Essence, which produces Virus Points over time.
Buy Dissolve Efficiency and Essence Density in the ER upgrades to speed this up.

achievements.summary: Have all four artifacts, Crystal Mirror, Magic Skull, Prosperity Engine and Emotional Vessel, at level 100 or higher.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 99} to unlock Artifacts, then press Flush to turn each Tarot resource into its golden form. Upgrade each artifact with its golden resource until all four reach level 100.

achievements.summary: Complete the Dominican Republic, Plague stage 4-5.

steps.text: Infect all 11,400,000 people of stage 4-5, Dominican Republic, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Have more than 1e9 Plague Generators (PlG).

steps.text: Complete stage 4-5, Dominican Republic, which pays 1.4e9 PlG on its own.

achievements.summary: Craft a Legendary (S rarity) Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER).

steps.text: Keep crafting ERs in the @loc{Plague} tab until one comes out at S rarity.
Buy Crafting Mastery in the ER upgrades to raise the chance.

achievements.description: Base Spread Power ER Upgrade Lv.25+
achievements.summary: Raise the Base Spread Power upgrade of the Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) to level 25 or higher.

steps.text: Spend Virus Points on the Base Spread Power ER upgrade until it reaches level 25.

achievements.summary: Dissolve one Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) for 1,000,000 or more Virus Essence (VE).

steps.text: Buy Dissolve Efficiency in the ER upgrades, then dissolve a Decay-type ER, which yields a high amount of Virus Essence.

achievements.summary: Complete the Netherlands, Plague stage 4-6.

steps.text: Infect all 18,500,000 people of stage 4-6, Netherlands, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Reach a spread speed of 2,000 or more in a Countries-level or later Plague stage.

steps.text: Reach the Countries level of @loc{Plague}, then raise spread speed with the Base Spread Power ER upgrade and with ERs that have high Spread Power, such as Outbreak or Strain types.

achievements.description: Reach 100,000,000+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have 100,000,000 or more of each golden Tarot resource (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 99} to unlock Artifacts, then press Flush to convert each Tarot resource into its golden form.
Keep flushing every suit until each golden resource reaches 100,000,000.

achievements.description: x10+ local artifact speed (shop boost does not apply)
achievements.summary: Reach x10 or higher Artifacts Local Speed without the shop boost.

steps.text: In the Tarot upgrades menu, buy Upgrade 8 of each suit, which adds Artifacts Local Speed Power and needs Upgrade 7 at level 2 or higher. Keep raising it until the speed multiplier reaches x10.

achievements.summary: Complete the four Page Tarot Challenges: Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups.

guide.context: Each Page unlocks only after the earlier challenges of its suit are complete.

steps.text: Enter Page of Swords in the Tarot challenges tab and reach Attack Level 2500.
Enter Page of Wands and reach a 1e2026 or higher multiplication of all elements.
Enter Page of Pentacles and reach Max Mineral Level 420 or higher.
Enter Page of Cups and Unite with a Level 100 or higher Zodiac.

achievements.summary: Infect 100,000,000 or more people in total.

steps.text: Keep completing Plague stages until the Total Infected statistic reaches 100,000,000.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 63.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 36,000, then buy @item{Relic 63} in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 110.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points on @mechanic{Refine Node 110} in the Refine Tree.

achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) of level 30 or higher.

steps.text: Raise the craft level in the @loc{Plague} tab one level at a time, crafting an ER at each level, until you craft at level 30 or higher.

achievements.summary: Complete Canada, Plague stage 4-7.

steps.text: Infect all 41,000,000 people of stage 4-7, Canada, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e1,000,000 or more Fire.

steps.text: In the Elements subtab of @mechanic{Unity}, select Fire to generate and let it build.
Boost Fire with Aries, Leo and Sagittarius zodiacs and Fire upgrades until it reaches 1e1,000,000.

achievements.description: Complete the Hanged Man Tarot Challenge
achievements.summary: Complete the Hanged Man Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: The Hanged Man challenge unlocks only after you complete The Strength challenge.

steps.text: Enter the Hanged Man challenge in the @loc{Tarot} challenges tab and reach x5e9 Minerals Local Speed.

achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 67 or higher.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 85}. For each Special Mineral type, destroy 100 of its minerals at Level 20 to sacrifice that type.
After every type is sacrificed, spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust and spend it to level each sacrificed mineral to level 67.

achievements.description: Refine at 10–50 sec after using the Death Card
achievements.summary: Do a Refine Prestige inside the Death Tarot Challenge, between 10 and 50 seconds after you activate the Death card.

guide.context: The Death challenge unlocks only after you complete The Hanged Man challenge.

steps.text: Enter the Death challenge and use the Death card.
Wait at least 10 seconds but no more than 50, then Refine.

achievements.summary: Reach level 61 or higher for Relic 61.

steps.text: Buy @item{Relic 61} repeatedly in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold until it reaches level 61.

achievements.description: Defeat a stage after the cure is ready (or complete all 60 basic plague challenges)
achievements.summary: Defeat a Plague stage once the cure is ready, or finish all 60 stages of Plague levels 1 to 5 (1-1 through 5-12).

steps.text: Reach the Islands level, where the healthy population starts working on a cure, wait until that cure is ready, then defeat the stage.
Or finish all 60 stages from 1-1 to 5-12.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 112.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points on @mechanic{Refine Node 112} in the Refine Tree.

achievements.summary: Complete Russia, Plague stage 4-10.

steps.text: Infect all 143,676,961 people of stage 4-10, Russia, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.description: Reach 1e9+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have 1e9 or more of each golden Tarot resource (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 99} to unlock Artifacts, then press Flush to convert each Tarot resource into its golden form.
Keep flushing every suit until each golden resource reaches 1e9.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 64.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 37,500, then buy @item{Relic 64} in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold.

achievements.summary: Complete the USA, Plague stage 4-11.

steps.text: Infect all 342,420,067 people of stage 4-11, USA, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Complete the Temperance Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: The Temperance challenge unlocks only after you complete the Death challenge.

steps.text: Enter the Temperance challenge and place the Temperate Zodiac you receive in the Fortune Pars slot right away.
Use Temperance to gain more Temperate Zodiacs, and put one that matches a ruling sign into each Planet slot until every slot is filled.

achievements.summary: Have 1e10,000 or more of each Tarot resource (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Raise generation of every Tarot suit with card and Tarot upgrades until all four resources reach 1e10,000.

achievements.description: Upgrade Refine Node 111 to max Lv.25
achievements.summary: Upgrade Refine Node 111 to its maximum level, 25.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Refine Node 111} in the Refine Tree, then spend Refine Points on it until it reaches level 25.

achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) of level 40 or higher.

steps.text: Raise the craft level in the @loc{Plague} tab one level at a time, crafting an ER at each level, until you craft at level 40 or higher.

achievements.summary: Complete China, Plague stage 4-12.

steps.text: Infect all 1.41e9 people of stage 4-12, China, in the @loc{Plague} tab.
steps.note: A cure can finish and slow your spread, so do not let the stage drag on.

achievements.summary: Complete the Knight of Swords, Knight of Wands, Knight of Pentacles and Knight of Cups Tarot Challenges.

guide.context: Tarot Challenges unlock with Refine Node 89, and each Knight challenge opens only after the Page challenge of the same suit.

steps.text: Knight of Swords: reach Attack Level 2560.
steps.note: A stronger equipped Endoplasmic Reticulum (more spread power) weakens the penalty.

steps.text: Knight of Wands: get all Elements to a combined product of 1e268.
steps.note: More Infectivity on the equipped Endoplasmic Reticulum weakens the penalty.

steps.text: Knight of Pentacles: reach Max Mineral Level 1000.
steps.note: More Stealth on the equipped Endoplasmic Reticulum weakens the penalty.

steps.text: Knight of Cups: Unite with a Zodiac of Level 625 or higher.
steps.note: A larger total infected population weakens the penalty.

achievements.description: Reach a combined total of 1e10+ golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have a combined total of at least 1e10 golden Tarot resources.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush in the @loc{Tarot} tab to turn Tarot resources into golden ones.
steps.note: A flush puts a ^0.001 penalty on resource generation that fades over 10 hours, and the Flush button then waits about 1 hour (10% of that).

steps.text: Keep flushing until golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups add up to 1e10.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 66.

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level to 39,000 to unlock @item{Relic 66}.
Buy @item{Relic 66} in the @loc{Relics} tab with Gold earned from Attacks.

achievements.summary: Complete Calnyth, Plague stage 5-3.

steps.text: Infect all 600,000,000 people of stage 5-3, Calnyth, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Infect at least 1e9 people during Plague stage 5-5, Earth.

steps.text: In the @loc{Plague} tab, start stage 5-5 (Earth) and keep spreading until 1e9 people are infected.
steps.note: The stage holds 8.3e9 people in total, so you do not have to finish it.

achievements.summary: Buy Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10.

steps.text: Collect 1,000,000 each of Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups, then open Tarot Upgrades.
Buy the Pentacles upgrades in order with Pentacles until you reach upgrade 10.
steps.note: Most upgrades need the one before at level 1 or higher; Pentacle-5 needs Pentacle-4 at level 4, and Pentacle-6, 7 and 8 each need the previous one at level 2.

achievements.description: Reach 1e10+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have at least 1e10 of every golden Tarot resource.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush in the @loc{Tarot} tab to turn Tarot resources into golden ones.
steps.note: A flush puts a ^0.001 penalty on resource generation that fades over 10 hours, and the Flush button then waits about 1 hour (10% of that).

steps.text: Keep flushing until golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups are each at 1e10.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 116.

steps.text: Spend Refine Points on Refine Node 116 in the Refine Tree of the @loc{Minerals} tab.

achievements.summary: Raise the Magic Skull artifact to level 200 or higher.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99 and flush Wands into golden Wands.
Upgrade the parts of the @item{Magic Skull} until the artifact reaches level 200.
steps.note: Upgrading does not use up golden Wands; you only need to hold the required amount.

achievements.summary: Complete Earth, Plague stage 5-5.

steps.text: Infect all 8.3e9 people of stage 5-5, Earth, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Infect a total of at least 1e11 people across all Plague stages.

steps.text: Keep completing and repeating Plague stages until your Total Infected reaches 1e11.
steps.note: Repeating stages unlocks after completing all Towns stages (2-1 to 2-12).

achievements.displayName: Nice, but not as funny as two numbers before
achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Level 69+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 69 or higher.

steps.text: In the sacrifice tab, delete 100 minerals at Level 20 of each Special Mineral type to sacrifice that type.
steps.note: Refine Node 85 unlocks the sacrifice tab.

steps.text: After all are sacrificed, spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust and spend it to raise every sacrificed mineral to level 69.

achievements.displayName: Too Dark For An Incremental Game
achievements.summary: Sacrifice Relic 58.

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level to 30,300 to unlock @item{Relic 58}.
Buy @item{Relic 58} in the @loc{Relics} tab until it reaches 301 levels, then sacrifice it.

achievements.displayName: The Devil Went Down To Dilation
achievements.summary: Complete the Devil Tarot Challenge.

steps.text: Open Tarot Challenges and start The Devil challenge.
steps.note: It unlocks once the Temperance challenge is complete.

steps.text: Use The Devil arcan, then click all 10 Chads it spawns.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e14 Plague Generators.

steps.text: Complete Plague stages in the @loc{Plague} tab to collect Plague Generators.
steps.note: Stage 5-5 (Earth) alone awards 2e14.

achievements.summary: Complete Brundar, Plague stage 5-8.

steps.text: Infect all 2.25e10 people of stage 5-8, Brundar, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Raise Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10 to level 4 or higher.

steps.text: Keep buying levels of Pentacle-10 with Pentacles until it reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Complete Valdecrum, Plague stage 5-11.

steps.text: Infect all 2.45e11 people of stage 5-11, Valdecrum, in the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.description: Reach 1e12+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have at least 1e12 of every golden Tarot resource.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush in the @loc{Tarot} tab to turn Tarot resources into golden ones.
steps.note: A flush puts a ^0.001 penalty on resource generation that fades over 10 hours, and the Flush button then waits about 1 hour (10% of that).

steps.text: Keep flushing until golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups are each at 1e12.
steps.note: Relic 59 and Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10 raise golden gain.

achievements.displayName: Literally Impossible, you have no chance to achieve this one
achievements.summary: Complete Plague stage 5-5 (Earth) and win the random chance the game then gives.

steps.text: Complete stage 5-5 (Earth) in the @loc{Plague} tab.
Buy @item{Relic 67} in the @loc{Relics} tab to raise the chance; it unlocks at Attack Level 40,067.
steps.note: Relic 67 stops mattering once the achievement is unlocked.

achievements.summary: Complete every regular Plague stage from 1-1 through 5-12.

steps.text: In the @loc{Plague} tab, finish all 12 stages of each of the five levels, ending with stage 5-12 (Omnharr, 7e11 people).

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e1,000,000 of each of the four Elements, Water included.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, grow Fire, Earth, Wind and Water until each is at 1e1,000,000.
steps.note: Only one Element generates at a time, so switch between them.

achievements.summary: Complete the Bonus Trial.

steps.text: Earn the achievement "Literally Impossible" to unlock the @mechanic{Bonus Trial}.
Lock the Bonus Trial, then press the blue reset button at the top right corner.
Complete Plague stage 5-5 (Earth) while only a Decay Endoplasmic Reticulum is equipped, at no more than 50% of the max level.

achievements.description: Reach 1e13+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have at least 1e13 of every golden Tarot resource.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush in the @loc{Tarot} tab to turn Tarot resources into golden ones.
steps.note: A flush puts a ^0.001 penalty on resource generation that fades over 10 hours, and the Flush button then waits about 1 hour (10% of that).

steps.text: Keep flushing until golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups are each at 1e13.
steps.note: Relic 59 and Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10 raise golden gain.

achievements.summary: Buy Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-11.
