steps.text: Raise Pentacle-10 to level 5 with Pentacles.
Buy Pentacle-11 with Pentacles; its first level costs 1e16500.

achievements.summary: Complete the Tower Tarot Challenge.

guide.context: A failed use resets your Universe High Score, Plague Points and every Endoplasmic Reticulum.

steps.text: Get 20,000 people infected in the Universe stage of the @loc{Plague} tab.
Start The Tower challenge in Tarot Challenges.
steps.note: It opens after The Devil challenge is complete.

steps.text: Use The Tower arcan inside the challenge until it completes.
steps.note: Each use is a chance, and Relic 67 raises that chance.

achievements.summary: Craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum of level 50 or higher.

steps.text: Unlock Endoplasmic Reticulum crafting with Refine Node 104.
In the @loc{Plague} tab, flush Plague Points to craft an Endoplasmic Reticulum and raise the craft level step by step to 50.
steps.note: Each craft level needs an Endoplasmic Reticulum of the previous level crafted first.

achievements.description: Reach 1e16+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Have at least 1e16 of every golden Tarot resource.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush in the @loc{Tarot} tab to turn Tarot resources into golden ones.
steps.note: A flush puts a ^0.001 penalty on resource generation that fades over 10 hours, and the Flush button then waits about 1 hour (10% of that).

steps.text: Keep flushing until golden Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups are each at 1e16.
steps.note: Relic 59 and Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10 raise golden gain.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice Relic 59.

steps.text: Raise your Attack Level to 31,000 to unlock @item{Relic 59}.
Buy @item{Relic 59} in the @loc{Relics} tab until it reaches 301 levels, then sacrifice it.

achievements.summary: Perform a Singularity.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 121 to unlock Singularity.
Perform your first Singularity in the @loc{Singularity} tab.

achievements.summary: Reach a total of 1e100 levels across all Tarot cards.

steps.text: Spawn Special Minerals until a Black Gem appears, then discard it to earn Tarot draws.
steps.note: A Black Gem is one random Special Mineral type with a low spawn chance, and it needs Refine Node 70. Five Level 1 Black Gems make one draw.

steps.text: Spend draws in the @loc{Tarot} tab to draw your cards.
Use The Sun arcan whenever it is ready to add levels to a random card you own, until the total of all card levels reaches 1e100.
steps.note: Arcans only appear in packs once your cards total 20 levels.

achievements.summary: Raise Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-10 to its maximum level.

steps.text: Keep buying levels of Pentacle-10 with Pentacles until it reaches its maximum of level 10.

achievements.summary: Raise Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-11 to level 2 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Pentacle-11, then buy its second level with Pentacles.
steps.note: Each level costs 1e3500 times more than the one before.

achievements.description: Complete the Special Sacrificer Progression Milestone
achievements.summary: Complete the Special Sacrificer Progression Milestone by sacrificing every Special Mineral.

guide.context: Progression Milestones reset on every Singularity and apply penalties until their requirement is met.

steps.text: Perform your first Singularity to unlock the Milestones tab, which lists the Progression Milestones.
Destroy 100 Level 20 minerals of one Special Mineral type to sacrifice that type.
steps.note: Deleting them, The Tower or a macro all count. The sacrificed Level 27 mineral then appears in the sacrifice tab, which Refine Node 85 unlocks.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral type after your latest Singularity.
steps.note: The milestone completes once all types are sacrificed.

achievements.description: Complete the Elementary Master Progression Milestone
achievements.summary: Complete the Elementary Master Progression Milestone by buying the last upgrade node of every Element.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, buy the final upgrade node of Fire, Earth, Wind and Water.

achievements.summary: Complete all eight Progression Milestones.

steps.text: Complete the first seven Progression Milestones, ending with Viral Ascension.
Complete Infinite Infection last.

achievements.description: Complete the Viral Ascension Progression Milestone
achievements.summary: Complete the Viral Ascension Progression Milestone by completing the six Progression Milestones before it.

steps.text: Sacrifice every Special Mineral.
Buy the last upgrade node of every Element.
Get all 78 Tarot cards.
Raise every sacrificed Special Mineral to level 40.
Get every Artifact part.
Complete Plague stage 5-12.
steps.note: Viral Ascension completes once all six are done in the same Singularity.

achievements.summary: Reach 1.4e154 Atoms.

steps.text: In the @loc{Singularity} tab, let Atoms grow; each second they multiply themselves, with your Singularity Multiplier setting the rate.
steps.note: Refine Nodes 126 and 127 remove the Atom-gain penalties at 1e50 and 1.4e154.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Level 77+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 77 or higher.

steps.text: In the sacrifice tab, delete 100 minerals at Level 20 of each Special Mineral type to sacrifice that type.
steps.note: Refine Node 85 unlocks the sacrifice tab.

steps.text: After all are sacrificed, spawn Special Minerals to earn Sacrifice Dust and spend it to raise every sacrificed mineral to level 77.

achievements.summary: Have 2 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Perform your first Singularity.
Grow Atoms back to 1.8e308 and perform a second Singularity.

achievements.summary: Have 8e9 people infected in the Universe stage.

steps.text: In the @loc{Plague} tab, reach the Universe stage (6-1) and keep spreading until 8e9 are infected.
steps.note: Immunity there is 1,000,000, so raise your spread speed first.

achievements.summary: Raise Tarot Upgrade Pentacle-11 to level 3 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Pentacle-11 levels with Pentacles until it reaches level 3.
steps.note: Each level costs 1e3500 times more than the one before.

achievements.summary: Have at least 1e18 Plague Generators.

steps.text: Keep completing and repeating Plague stages to collect Plague Generators.
steps.note: Awards stop shrinking after your third Singularity, and Singularity Tree Node 5.2 raises them.

achievements.description: Obtain a Prime+67 Zodiac or better
achievements.summary: Obtain a Prime+67 Zodiac or a better one.

steps.text: Unlock the Prime rarity by merging three Amazing+1000 Zodiacs.
Raise Luck, then Unite until a Prime+67 or better Zodiac appears.
steps.note: The Prime luck range starts at 1.57e1472.

achievements.description: Complete the Infinite Infection Progression Milestone
achievements.summary: Complete the Infinite Infection Progression Milestone by reaching 1e12 infected in the Universe stage with at least 4 Singularities and every earlier milestone done.

steps.text: Complete every earlier Progression Milestone.
Have at least 4 Singularities.
Reach 1e12 infected in the Universe stage of the @loc{Plague} tab.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e2,000,000 Fire.

steps.text: In the @loc{Elements} tab, generate Fire and keep growing it to 1e2,000,000.
steps.note: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius Zodiacs speed up Fire, and a Singular Aries Zodiac adds to Fire Factor 3.

achievements.summary: Have 5 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Perform Singularities, each at 1.8e308 Atoms, until your Singularity count reaches 5.
steps.note: Plague is kept on reset from the third Singularity.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e1e15 Gold (10 raised to the power 1e15).

steps.text: Earn Gold from @mechanic{Attacks}; each Unite pays out the Gold shown on the Attacks screen.
Keep adding Singularities and Singularity Tree Node 2 levels, which raise Gold gain by a power, until you hold 1e1e15 Gold.

achievements.description: Upgrade Singularity Tree Node 1 to Lv.3+
achievements.summary: Raise Singularity Tree Node 1 to at least Level 3.

guide.context: Tree purchases divide your Atoms instead of subtracting from them, so check the Atom count after each buy.

steps.text: Reach 5 Singularities to unlock the Tree tab in @mechanic{Singularity}.
Buy Node 1 three times.

achievements.summary: Have 10 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 121 to unlock @mechanic{Singularity} in the Unity tab.
Reach 1.8e308 Atoms, perform a Singularity, and keep going until the Singularity count is 10.

achievements.description: Ascend Singularity Tree Node 1 to Ascension 1+
achievements.summary: Ascend Singularity Tree Node 1 once, so its Ascension is 1 or more.

steps.text: Buy Singularity Tree Node 1 up to Level 10.
Press Ascend on Node 1.

achievements.description: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x2+
achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x2 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier on the Singularity tab shows x2 or higher.
steps.note: More gain factors unlock as you progress, such as Atoms, Singularity Tree Node 1 and Refine Node 125.

achievements.summary: Raise the Emotional Vessel artifact to level 300 or higher.

steps.text: Unlock Artifacts with Refine Node 99, then press Flush on the Tarot tab to turn Cups resources into Golden Cups.
Use your Golden Cups to get and upgrade Emotional Vessel parts until the Emotional Vessel shows Level 300.
steps.note: Upgrading a part does not spend Golden Cups; you only need to hold the required amount.

achievements.description: Upgrade Singularity Tree Node 2 to Lv.1+
achievements.summary: Upgrade Singularity Tree Node 2 to Level 1 or higher.

steps.text: Reach 5 Singularities to unlock the Tree tab in @mechanic{Singularity}.
Buy at least one level of Singularity Tree Node 1 with Atoms (base cost 1e300).
Buy Level 1 of Node 2 (base cost 1e400).

achievements.summary: Sacrifice Relic 60.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 32,500 to unlock Relic 60 on the Relics tab.
Buy Relic 60 with Gold until you own 301 levels of it.
Use the sacrifice option on Relic 60.

achievements.summary: Have 20 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Keep performing Singularities with enough Atoms each time. The Singularity needed to reach 20 asks for about 1e500 Atoms.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Lv.80+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 80 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 85, then sacrifice each Special Mineral type by deleting 100 of its minerals that are Level 20.
Spawn Special Minerals to collect Sacrifice Dust.
Spend Sacrifice Dust to level every sacrificed Special Mineral to Level 80.

achievements.description: Reach 1e20+ of all golden tarot resources
achievements.summary: Reach 1e20 or more of every golden Tarot resource.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 99 to unlock Artifacts.
In the Artifacts section of the Tarot tab, press Flush to turn Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups into their golden forms.
Keep building golden resources until all four are at 1e20 or more.
steps.note: Singularity Tree Node 4.2 and a larger Atom count raise Golden Resource gain; Refine Node 100 and Relic 58 shorten the Flush cooldown.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 69.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 42,000 to unlock Relic 69.
Buy Relic 69 with Gold.

achievements.description: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x5+
achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x5 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier shows x5 or higher.
steps.note: Add gain factors as they unlock: Atoms, Singularity Tree Node 1 and Refine Node 125.

achievements.description: Upgrade Singularity Tree Nodes 3-1 and 3-2 to Level 1+
achievements.summary: Get both Singularity Tree Node 3.1 and Node 3.2 to at least Level 1.

steps.text: Buy Singularity Tree Node 2 first.
Buy Level 1 of Node 3.1 and Level 1 of Node 3.2.

achievements.description: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x10+
achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x10 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier shows x10 or higher.
steps.note: At 20 Singularities the Singularity Count also becomes a gain factor.

achievements.summary: Craft a level 60 or higher Endoplasmic Reticulum.

guide.context: Each craft level needs an Endoplasmic Reticulum of the previous level crafted first.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 103 and 104 to unlock Plague and its Endoplasmic Reticulum section.
Flush Plague Points to build Endoplasmic Reticulum Points and craft.
Raise the craft level until you craft a Level 60 Endoplasmic Reticulum.

achievements.description: Purchase Refine Node 125 and upgrade it to Level 3+
achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 125, then raise that node to Level 3 or more.

steps.text: Open the Refine Tree in the Minerals tab and buy Refine Node 125.
Level Refine Node 125 up to Level 3.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e5000 or more Refine Points.

steps.text: Perform Refine Prestige from the Minerals tab to earn Refine Points; it needs a Level 70 mineral.
Keep raising Refine Point gain until you hold 1e5000.
steps.note: Singularity Tree Node 4.1, Refine Nodes 129 and 134, and a larger Singularity Multiplier all raise Refine Point gain.

achievements.summary: Raise Base Spread Power (Endoplasmic Reticulum Upgrade 1) to Level 100 or higher.

steps.text: Dissolve unwanted Endoplasmic Reticula to get Virus Essence, which produces Virus Points.
Spend Virus Points on Endoplasmic Reticulum Upgrade 1, Base Spread Power, until it is Level 100.
steps.note: The cost starts at 1000 and doubles each level.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Level 82+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 82 or higher.

steps.text: Sacrifice each Special Mineral type with Refine Node 85 by deleting 100 of its minerals that are Level 20, so Sacrifice Dust starts.
Open the Sacrifice tab in Minerals and spend Sacrifice Dust to level every sacrificed Special Mineral to Level 82.

achievements.summary: Max out every Tarot Upgrade.

steps.text: Collect a million of each Tarot resource (Swords, Wands, Pentacles, Cups) to unlock Tarot Upgrades.
In each suit, buy the upgrades in order, because each needs the one before it at a minimum level.
Raise Upgrade 4 (it lifts the max level of Upgrades 1-4) and Upgrade 9 (it lifts the max level of Upgrades 5-8), then max out every upgrade in all four suits.

achievements.summary: Complete all four Tarot Queen challenges (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 89 to unlock Tarot Challenges. Each suit's challenges must be done in order, so finish the lower cards first.
Queen of Swords: reach Attack Level 3250 inside the challenge.
Queen of Wands: reach 1e3000 or more multiplication of all elements.
Queen of Pentacles: reach Max Mineral Level 700 or more.
Queen of Cups: Unite with a Level 6 or higher Zodiac.

achievements.description: Reach a Next Singularity Multiplier of x2+
achievements.summary: Get the Next Singularity Award, the Singularity Multiplier your next Singularity would give, to x2 or more.

steps.text: Raise the factors that feed Singularity Mult gain: Atoms, Singularity Tree Node 1 and Refine Node 125, then Singular Zodiacs and completed Tarot King challenges.
Judge progress by the Next Singularity Award, not by the total from all factors.
steps.note: From 20 Singularities the Singularity Count also counts as a factor, and from 64 Singularities the Singularity Mult itself does.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e1000 or more Atoms.

steps.text: Perform a Singularity, then let Atoms grow; they multiply every second according to your Singularity Multiplier.
Weaken Atom penalties with Refine Nodes 126, 127 and 128 and Singularity Tree Nodes 3.1, 3.2 and 6.2.
steps.note: Penalties on Atom gain grow steeply past 1e500 and at 1e1000.

achievements.summary: Unlock Singular Houses, which requires 32 Singularities.

steps.text: Keep performing Singularities until the Singularity count is 32; the Houses tab then unlocks. The Singularity needed to reach 32 asks for about 1e696 Atoms.

achievements.summary: Obtain your first Singular Zodiac.

steps.text: Reach 32 Singularities to unlock Houses.
Perform a Singularity with at least 1e1000 Atoms.

achievements.description: Have 3+ Singular Zodiacs in your inventory
achievements.summary: Have 3 or more Singular Zodiacs in your inventory.

steps.text: Perform Singularities with at least 1e1000 Atoms until you hold 3 Singular Zodiacs.
Do not delete them.
steps.note: Each such Singularity gives one Singular Zodiac.

achievements.summary: Have 50 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Keep performing Singularities; each one needs more Atoms than the last.

achievements.summary: Equip all 12 Singular Zodiacs.

steps.text: Reach 32 Singularities to unlock the Houses tab.
Perform Singularities with at least 1e1000 Atoms to collect Singular Zodiacs, until you have one for each of the 12 signs, Aries through Pisces.
Place each one in its matching house on the Houses circle.

achievements.summary: Obtain a Singular Zodiac of Rare rarity or higher.

steps.text: Reach 32 Singularities to unlock the Houses tab.
Perform Singularities with at least 1e1000 Atoms until a Singular Zodiac of Rare rarity or better drops.

achievements.description: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x100+
achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x100 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier shows x100 or higher.
steps.note: Useful gain factors: Singularity Tree Node 1, Refine Node 125, completed Tarot King challenges and Singular Zodiacs.

achievements.summary: Craft a level 67 or higher Endoplasmic Reticulum.

guide.context: Each craft level needs an Endoplasmic Reticulum of the previous level crafted first.

steps.text: Open the Endoplasmic Reticulum section of the Plague tab and craft up to a Level 67 Endoplasmic Reticulum.

achievements.summary: Obtain a Singular Zodiac of Legendary rarity or higher.

steps.text: Reach 32 Singularities to unlock the Houses tab.
Perform Singularities with at least 1e1000 Atoms until a Singular Zodiac of Legendary rarity or better drops.

achievements.description: Upgrade Singularity Tree Node 8 to Level 5+
achievements.summary: Raise Singularity Tree Node 8 to at least Level 5.

steps.text: Buy each earlier Singularity Tree node at least once, in order.
Buy Node 8 up to Level 5.

achievements.summary: Have 67 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Keep performing Singularities; each one needs more Atoms than the last.

achievements.summary: Have a Mineral at Level 3,000 or higher.

guide.context: Singularities reset your Minerals until you reach 16 Singularities.

steps.text: Merge matching minerals to make a higher-level mineral, and keep merging until one reaches Level 3,000.

achievements.description: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x1,000+
achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x1,000 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier shows x1,000 or higher.
steps.note: At 64 Singularities the Singularity Multiplier itself also becomes a gain factor.

achievements.description: Reach 1e256+ Levels on The Devil Tarot Card
achievements.summary: Reach 1e256 or more levels on The Devil Tarot card.

steps.text: Draw Tarot cards until your cards total 20 levels, so arcans can appear in packs, then keep drawing until you own @item{The Devil}.
Use @item{The Sun} whenever its 10-hour cooldown ends, and check The Devil's level on the Tarot tab.
steps.note: The Sun raises one owned card chosen by chance, so you cannot point it at The Devil.

achievements.summary: Complete all four Tarot King challenges (Swords, Wands, Pentacles and Cups).

steps.text: Finish the Queen challenge of each suit first.
Before entering a King challenge, have 1.8e308 Atoms; entering performs a Singularity and resets your Atoms to 1.
King of Swords: Singularize once Attack Level 5005 has been reached in the challenge.
King of Wands: perform a Singularity with 1e2026 or more Fire.
King of Pentacles: perform a Singularity at 1e200 or more Value Points (VP).
King of Cups: Singularize when the Zodiac level you would get next is 67 or above.

achievements.summary: Buy Relic 70.

steps.text: Reach Attack level 45,800 to unlock Relic 70.
Buy Relic 70 with Gold.

achievements.summary: Buy Refine Node 136.

steps.text: Earn Refine Points through Refine Prestige.
Open the Refine Tree in the Minerals tab and buy Refine Node 136.

achievements.description: Obtain a Rainbow+ Common Zodiac or a Godly+ Singular Zodiac
achievements.summary: Obtain a Singular Zodiac of Godly rarity or higher.

steps.text: Reach 32 Singularities to unlock the Houses tab.
Perform Singularities with at least 1e1000 Atoms until a Singular Zodiac of Godly rarity or better drops.

achievements.summary: Reach 1e18 or more Infected in the Universe.

steps.text: Work through the Plague levels until Level 6, Universes, opens.
Click Initiate Infection on the Universe stage and let Infected in the Universe grow to 1e18.

achievements.description: Have all sacrificed Special Minerals at Level 90+
achievements.summary: Have every sacrificed Special Mineral at level 90 or higher.

steps.text: Buy Refine Node 85, then sacrifice each Special Mineral type by deleting 100 of its minerals that are Level 20, so Sacrifice Dust starts.
Open the Sacrifice tab in Minerals and spend Sacrifice Dust to level every sacrificed Special Mineral to Level 90.

achievements.summary: Reach a Singularity Multiplier of x1,000,000 or higher.

steps.text: Perform Singularities until the Singularity Multiplier shows x1,000,000 or higher.
steps.note: Stack every gain factor, including the Singularity Multiplier itself, which becomes a factor at 64 Singularities.

achievements.summary: Craft a level 100 or higher Endoplasmic Reticulum.

guide.context: Each craft level needs an Endoplasmic Reticulum of the previous level crafted first.

steps.text: In the Endoplasmic Reticulum section of the Plague tab, craft a Level 100 Endoplasmic Reticulum.

achievements.summary: Have 100 or more Singularities.

steps.text: Keep performing Singularities; the 100th asks for about 1e4071 Atoms.

achievements.summary: Get a Rainbow or higher Common Zodiac.

steps.text: Merge three Prime+1000 Common Zodiacs to unlock Rainbow rarity.
Keep uniting until a Common Zodiac of Rainbow rarity or higher appears.
